kanji.tip: Only とう is used, in party words from the news. Same sound as 島 and 東, so read the context.
Only きょう. Learn 協力 (cooperation) first.
Only そう in common words. すべて (all) is normally written in kana.
Only く. You see it in Tokyo addresses like 新宿区 (しんじゅくく).
Only りょう. 領収書 (receipt) is useful in shops and offices.
Only けん, as in 千葉県 (ちばけん). Japan has 47 prefectures: 都, 道, 府 and 43 県.
せつ is the main reading. Trap: in 設計 it becomes せっ.
改札口 (ticket gate) is the most useful word at train stations. Don't confuse 改 with 攻 or 故.
Only ふ. Only Osaka and Kyoto are 府. Don't mix it up with 付 or 符.
Only さ, always at the end of these words. 検査 (test) is common at hospitals.
い is the reading you need. 委 looks like 季 (season) and 香 (smell): check the bottom part.
Only ぐん in common words. It has 車 (car) inside, but it is not read くるま.
だん is the main reading. Trap: 布団 (futon) uses とん.
かく is the main reading. Trap: 各国 is かっこく. Don't confuse 各 with 名 or 客.
Alone it is しま; in compound words it is often とう. Trap: in names しま can become じま, like 桜島 (さくらじま).
Alone it is かわ (leather). Trap: 皮 is also かわ but means skin or peel.
Alone it is むら. Don't confuse 村 with 材 (wood, ざい).
大勢 (many people) is the key N4 word. Trap: there せい becomes ぜい.
へる and へらす matter most. お腹が減る means to get hungry. Opposite: 増える.
さい is the main reading. Trap: 再来週 and 再来年 use さ.
Only ぜい. Shop prices may say 税込 (tax included). Don't confuse 税 with 説 or 脱.
えい is the reading you need. 営業中 on a shop sign means it is open.
くらべる is the useful word at N4. Don't confuse 比 with 北 (north).
ぼう is the main reading. Trap: 防止 ぼうし sounds like 帽子 (hat).

words.en: to make up for, to supplement

kanji.tip: ほ is the main reading, as in 候補 (candidate). The left side is 衣 (clothes), not 示.
きょう is the main reading, as in 環境. Trap: 境内 (shrine grounds) uses けい.
どう is the reading you need. 導 is 道 (road) with 寸 under it: guiding someone along the road.
Only ふく. Don't confuse 副 (vice, sub) with 福 (luck), also ふく.
Only さん. Trap: after another word it can become ざん, as in 引き算 and 足し算.
Only ゆ in common words. Don't confuse 輸 with 輪 (ring, わ).
のべる is the most useful word. Don't confuse 述 with 術 (じゅつ, as in 技術).
Only せん in common words. At stations, 3番線 (さんばんせん) means platform 3.
Only のう. Don't confuse 農 with 濃 (thick, dark), which has water on the left.
Only しゅう in common words. Don't confuse 州 with 川 (river) or 洲.
ぶ is the reading you need. Trap: 武道 ぶどう sounds like ぶどう (grapes).
Alone it is ぞう (elephant). In compound words it is usually しょう.
Only いき. 地域 (area) is the word to learn.
がく is the main reading. Alone it can be がく (frame) or ひたい (forehead): context decides.
Only おう in common words. It means Europe. Don't confuse 欧 with 区 or 次.
たん is the main reading. 担当 (person in charge) is very common at work.
Only じゅん. 準備 (preparation) is an N4 word, so learn it now.
Only しょう. Don't confuse 賞 with 党 or 常: they share the top part.
この辺 (around here) and この辺り mean almost the same. Watch the reading: へん vs あたり.
ぞう is the main reading. Trap: 作る is the everyday つくる; 造る is for ships, buildings or sake.
かぶる (put on a hat) is the N4 word, often written in kana. ひ appears in news words like 被害.
ぎ is the main reading, as in 技術. Don't confuse 技 with 枝 (branch).
ひくい is the N4 word. Opposite: 高い. 最低 can also mean awful.
Only ふく. Don't confuse 復 with 複 (double) or 腹 (belly), also ふく.
移動 and うつる are the useful ones. Trap: 写す and 映す are also うつす.
こ is the counter for small things. Trap: 一個 いっこ, 六個 ろっこ, 十個 じゅっこ.
Only もん in common words. Don't mix up 門 (gate), 問 (question) and 間 (between).
Only か. Textbooks use it: 第1課 (だいいっか) is lesson 1.
Only のう. Don't confuse 脳 (brain) with 悩 (worry, as in 悩む).
きょく is the main reading. Trap: 北極 is ほっきょく, and 積極的 is せっきょくてき.
You only need ふくむ and ふくめる. Example: 税金を含む (tax included).
冷蔵庫 (fridge) is the word to learn. Don't confuse 蔵 with 臓 (organ), also ぞう.
りょう is the main reading. Trap: はかる can also be 計る or 測る.
After another word かた often becomes がた, as in 血液型. Don't confuse 型 with 形 (shape), also かた.
Only きょう. 状況 (situation) is very common.
Alone it is はり (needle). しん is in 方針 (policy).
せん is the reading you need. Trap: 専 has no dot on the right, unlike 博.
Alone it is たに. In place names it is often や, like 渋谷 and 四谷.
Only し. Don't confuse 史 (history) with 吏 or 使.
かい is the floor counter. Trap: 一階 いっかい, 三階 さんがい, 何階 なんがい.
かん is the reading you need. Don't confuse 管 (pipe) with 官 (official), also かん.
へい is the main reading. Trap: 兵庫県 (near Kobe) uses ひょう.
Only せつ in common words. 面接 (job interview) is useful.
Trap: 細い (ほそい, thin) and 細かい (こまかい, small, detailed) look alike. Check the okurigana.
Trap: 効く (medicine works) and 聞く (listen) are both きく.
まる is the reading you need. Don't confuse 丸 with 九 (nine).
Only わん. You see it in 台湾 (Taiwan).
Only ろく. Don't confuse 録 with 緑 (green, みどり).
しょう is for ministries. Trap: 反省 (reflecting on your mistake) uses せい. Don't confuse 省 with 少.
Only きゅう. It means old or former. Don't confuse 旧 with 日 or 申.
Alone it is はし. Trap: 箸 (chopsticks) is also はし; in names it can be ばし, like 日本橋.
Alone it is きし. In 川岸 it becomes ぎし. 海岸 uses がん.
まわり is the useful one. Trap: 回り is also まわり (turning around).
Only ざい. Don't confuse 材 (material) with 村 (village).
と is the reading you need. Trap: it can become ど, as in 雨戸 and 江戸.
Only おう, almost always in 中央 (center). Don't confuse 央 with 英 or 史.
Only けん. 定期券 (commuter pass) is a useful word. Don't confuse 券 with 巻 (roll), which looks similar.
An N2 kanji, so you can skip it for N4. 編む (to knit) is the easiest word.
Learn 探す (N4) first. 捜す is used when looking for something lost, like a missing person.
たけ is the one to know. Its top form ⺮ appears in many kanji, like 箱 and 答.
In casual talk 超 means 'super', like 超おいしい. 超える (go over a limit) and 越える (cross over) sound the same.

words.en: to arrange, put in a row

kanji.tip: 並ぶ (to line up) and 並べる (to put in a row) are N4 words. Watch the pair: ぶ is intransitive, べる is transitive.
Only りょう, in medical words. Note the sickness part 疒 on the outside.
さい is the main reading. 採る is a special とる for picking or hiring; for everyday 'take' use 取る.
Three trees (木) make a forest: もり is the reading to know. 林 (two trees) is a smaller wood.
きょう in 競争 (competition) is the main one. けい only appears in betting sports like 競馬.
紹介 (introduction) is an N4 word: 紹介します is how you introduce someone.
屋根 (roof) and 大根 (radish) are the useful words. Same kanji: ね in one, こん in the other.
Only はん. 自動販売機 (vending machine) is everywhere in Japan; short form 自販機.
歴史 (history) is the N4 word. Don't confuse 歴 with 暦 (calendar), which has 日 at the bottom.
将来 (the future, your plans) is the useful word. The other readings are rare.
Only はば really matters. 大幅に (greatly) shows up in news about prices.
Almost always in 一般 いっぱん (general). Note はん changes to ぱん.
Only one word to know: 貿易 (foreign trade).
Only こう. 講義 (university lecture) is the most useful.
はやし is the reading to know (also a common surname). Two trees make 林, three make 森.
そう in 服装 (what you wear) is the most useful. 衣装 (costume) uses しょう.
An advanced kanji, you can skip it for N4. Don't mix it up with 緒 in 一緒.
Only げき. Don't confuse 劇 with 激 (strong, violent), also read げき.
For everyday 'river' use 川. 河 is a big river; in 運河 and 銀河 か becomes が.
Only こう. 航空 shows up at airports, as in 日本航空 (Japan Airlines).
地下鉄 (subway) is an N4 word, so てつ is the one to know.
じ is the main reading, in words about children like 育児.
Learn the signs 禁煙 (no smoking) and 立入禁止 (no entry). Only きん.
いん in 印刷 (printing) is most useful. しるし becomes じるし in words like 矢印.
ぎゃく is most common: 逆に means 'on the contrary'.
交換 (exchange) and 乗り換える (change trains) are the key words. 換える, 変える and 替える all sound the same.
久しぶり (long time no see) is the word you need now.
短い (short) is an N5 word; its opposite is 長い. たん is in harder words.
あぶら is oil; fat on meat is 脂, also あぶら. 醤油 (soy sauce) uses ゆ.
乱暴 (rough, violent) is the most useful. ばく only appears in a few hard words like 暴露.
指輪 (ring for your finger) is the easiest word. りん is in 車輪 and words for wheels.
占う (tell fortunes) and 占める (take up, occupy) share a kanji, so read the okurigana.
植物 (plant) and 植える (to plant) are the key words.
清潔 (clean, hygienic) is the most useful. Don't confuse 清 with 晴 (sunny) or 静 (quiet).
倍 means 'times': 二倍 is twice, 三倍 is three times.
Only 平均 (average) matters now.
Japanese counts big numbers in 万 (10,000) and 億 (100,000,000), not in millions.
Only あつ. It is not related to 暑い or 厚い, which are also あつ.
Only げい. 芸能人 (TV celebrity) is common in daily life.
Don't confuse 署 with 暑 (hot): 署 has 罒 on top, 暑 has 日.
伸びる and 伸ばす are the useful words: 髪を伸ばす (grow your hair).
Only てい. For the verb 'stop' use 止まる.
Only ばく, in words like 爆発 (explosion). Not needed for N4.
Only りく. 着陸 (landing) and 離陸 (take-off) are airport words.
たま becomes だま in words like 百円玉 (100 yen coin). Don't confuse 玉 with 王 (king), which has no dot.
なみ (wave) is the main reading. は becomes ぱ in 電波 (phone signal).
携帯 (mobile phone) is the word you will use most.

words.en: to be put off, be extended

kanji.tip: 延ばす (put off) and 伸ばす (stretch) sound the same: 延 is about time, 伸 is about length.
羽 is the counter for birds: 一羽 いちわ, but 三羽 is さんば and 六羽 is ろっぱ.
固い, 硬い and 堅い are all かたい (hard); 固い is the general one.
Only そく. 規則 (rules) is the useful word.
乱暴 (rough, violent) is the one to learn first.
普通 (normal, also 'local train') is an N4 word. 普 only has ふ.
測る (measure length or depth) is one of several はかる verbs: 計る is for time, 量る for weight.
豊か (rich, plentiful) is the most useful word.
厚い (thick) sounds the same as 暑い (hot weather) and 熱い (hot to touch). Learn which kanji goes with which.
Only れい. 年齢 (age) appears on forms.
雰囲気 (atmosphere) is very common: it is ふんいき, not ふいんき.
卒業 (graduation) is an N4 word. Don't confuse 卒 with 率 (rate).
Only りゃく matters. 省略 means shortening, like スマホ for スマートフォン.
承知しました means 'certainly' in polite work Japanese. 承る is humble keigo.
順番 (turn, order) is the useful word: 順番を待つ (wait your turn).
Mountain (山) over stone (石) makes 岩. いわ is the one to know.
練習 (practice) is an N4 word; れん is all you need now.
軽い (light) is an N4 word. かる becomes がる in 気軽に (feel free, casually).
了解 (OK, got it) is common in casual messages.
Only ちょう, for big government offices like 県庁.
城 alone is しろ, but castle names use じょう: 大阪城 おおさかじょう.
患者 (patient) is the only word you are likely to need.
Only そう. 一層 (even more) is used in formal writing.
はん often changes to ぱん or ばん: 出版 しゅっぱん. Don't confuse 版 with 板 (board).
Only れい. 令和 is the name of the current era (since 2019).
角 かど (street corner) is an N4 word: 角を曲がる (turn the corner).
連絡 (contact, get in touch) is the word you need.
損 (loss) is the opposite of 得 (gain). 損する means 'to lose out'.
ぼ is the one to know, as in 募集 on job ads. Not needed for N5/N4.
うら matters most. Its opposite is 表 おもて (front).
Learn 仏教 ぶっきょう first: ぶつ becomes ぶっ. ふつ means France, as in 日仏.
成績 (school grades) is the useful word. Do not mix up 績, 積 and 責 (all せき).
ちく in 建築 is the one to know. Not needed for N5/N4.
Only か is used. Do not mix up 貨 with 貸 (lend).
For N4, know 混む (こむ): 電車が混んでいる means the train is crowded.
Trap: 上る, 登る and 昇る are all のぼる. At N4 you mostly see 上る and 登る.
いけ and 電池 are the useful ones. Do not mix up 池 with 地 and 他.
血 alone is ち. Note 鼻血 はなぢ: ち becomes ぢ.
Trap: 温かい is for things (soup), 暖かい is for weather. Both are あたたかい.
季節 is the word to know. Do not mix up 季 with 李 or 委.
星 alone is ほし (becomes ぼし in 流れ星). Planet names use せい.
えい is the main reading. For normal long, use 長い, not 永い.
ちょ in 著者 is the one to know. Do not mix up 著 with 箸 (chopsticks).
Learn 雑誌 ざっし, an N4 word.
Only こ is common. 冷蔵庫 (fridge) is the useful word.
Only かん is used. Not needed for N5/N4.
Trap: 像 (image) and 象 (elephant) are both ぞう. 像 has the person part 亻.
かおり is the useful word. 匂い (におい) is the everyday word for smell.
Only さか is common (ざか after another word). Do not mix up 坂 with 阪 in 大阪.
そこ is the useful reading. Do not confuse it with そこ (there), written in kana.
Learn 財布 さいふ for N4. Do not mix up 布 with 希 (which contains 布).
Say お寺 (おてら). Temple names end in じ, like 金閣寺 きんかくじ. Do not mix up 寺 with 時 and 持.
Almost only used in 宇宙. Not needed for N5/N4.
Only きょ is used. Not needed for N5/N4.
Learn 地震 じしん for N4. Note 地 is じ here, not ち.
希望 is the word to know. Do not mix up 希 with 布 (cloth).
For N4, know 触る さわる. Same kanji, different reading in 触れる ふれる.
Only い is common. Not needed for N5/N4.
Only せき is used. Do not mix up 籍 with 績 and 積.
For N5/N4, know 汚い きたない. Same kanji is よご in 汚れる.
まい is a counter for flat things (paper, shirts, tickets). N5 must know.
Only ふく is used. Do not mix up 複 with 復 and 腹.
Learn 郵便局 for N5/N4. Only ゆう is used.
なか matters most. Trap: 仲 (relationship) and 中 (inside) are both なか.
えい in 栄養 is the useful one. Not needed for N5/N4.
さつ (paper money) and 改札 are useful. お札 can also be おふだ (a lucky charm).
Learn 黒板 こくばん. Alone it is いた. はん becomes ぱん in 鉄板.
骨 alone is ほね. こつ becomes こっ in 骨折.
傾向 けいこう is the most useful word. Not needed for N5/N4.
Only とど is used. 届ける (send) and 届く (arrive) are a useful pair for N4.
ま (巻く) is the main reading. かん counts book volumes.
も matters most: 燃えるごみ is burnable trash, seen on every bin.
Trap: 跡 (mark) and 後 (after) are both あと. Not needed for N5/N4.
つつむ and 包丁 are the useful words.
Learn 駐車場 for N4. Do not mix up 駐 (馬, horse) with 注 and 住.
For N5/N4, know 弱い よわい, the opposite of 強い つよい.
Almost only in 紹介 (しょうかい), an N4 word: 紹介します means let me introduce.
やとう is the useful word. Do not mix up 雇 with 顧.
か matters most (がえ after another word). Trap: 替える, 変える and 換える are all かえる.
あず is the useful reading. Do not mix up 預 with 予 (also よ).
や matters most: 焼く, 焼き鳥, 夕焼け (sunset).
Learn 簡単 かんたん for N5/N4. Only かん is common.
Only しょう is used. In 第一章, 一 changes to いっ, not 章.
Only ぞう is used. Do not mix up 臓 with 蔵 (storehouse).
りつ in 法律 is the one to know. Not needed for N5/N4.
Trap: 贈る (give a gift) and 送る (send) are both おくる.
照れる (feel shy) is common in speech. Not needed for N5/N4.
うすい matters most: thin (book), weak (tea), light (color). Opposite of 厚い and 濃い.
Not needed for N5/N4. ぐん also appears in 群馬 (ぐんま), a prefecture.
Only びょう is used. Do not mix up 秒 with 砂 (sand) and 少.
Learn 奥さん おくさん for N5/N4. おう is rare.

words.en: to be blocked, to be packed

kanji.tip: Only つ is common (づ in 缶詰). Not needed for N5/N4.
双子 ふたご is the useful word. Not needed for N5/N4.
刺身 さしみ and 名刺 めいし are the useful words. Do not mix up 刺 with 制.
Only じゅん is used. Not needed for N5/N4.
Only よく is used. Note 翌日 is よくじつ, not よくにち.
かい is the main reading. Not needed for N5/N4.

words.en: one side, one of a pair

kanji.tip: かた matters most: 片付ける is an N4 word. へん becomes ぺん in 断片.
敬語 (polite Japanese) is the useful word. Do not mix up 敬 with 警 and 驚.
なや is the useful reading. Do not mix up 悩 with 脳 (brain).
温泉 おんせん is the word to know. 泉 is white (白) over water (水).
皮 alone is かわ. Trap: 皮 (skin), 革 (leather) and 川 (river) are all かわ.
Trap: 漁師 is りょうし, not ぎょし. Not needed for N5/N4.

words.en: to be rough, to be stormy

kanji.tip: Not needed for N5/N4. Do not mix up 荒 with 流.
貯金 ちょきん is the word to know for N4.
Trap: 硬い, 固い and 堅い are all かたい. 硬 means hard like stone.

words.en: to be filled, to be buried

kanji.tip: う is the useful reading. Not needed for N5/N4.
柱 alone is はしら. Do not mix up 柱 with 注 and 住 (all have 主).
まつり (festival) matters most. Do not mix up 祭 with 際 (さい, edge or occasion).
Learn ふくろ. In compounds it often becomes ぶくろ: 手袋 てぶくろ, 紙袋 かみぶくろ.
鉛筆 えんぴつ (pencil) is an N5 word: ひつ changes to ぴつ there.
Only くん is useful. You already know it from 訓読み (the Japanese reading of a kanji).
浴びる (シャワーを浴びる, take a shower) is the useful one. 浴衣 is a special reading: ゆかた.
どう is the only reading you need. It means child, as in 童話 (fairy tale).
たから (treasure) is the main word. ほう appears in 宝石 (jewel).
Learn 封筒 ふうとう (envelope). ほう is rare: mainly 封建 (feudal).
むね (chest) matters most. It becomes むな before some words, like 胸元.
砂糖 さとう (sugar) is the word to know. Alone, sand is すな.
Learn しお (salt). えん is for harder words like 塩分 (salt content).
賢い かしこい (clever) is the word to know.
うで (arm) matters most, as in 腕時計 (wristwatch). うで also means skill.
ちょう means trillion: 一兆 いっちょう. Do not confuse with 北 (north).
ゆか (floor) is most useful. とこ is in 床屋 (barber). Alone, 床 is usually ゆか.
け (hair, fur) matters most, as in 髪の毛. もう is in 毛布 (blanket).
みどり (green) matters most. Do not mix up 緑 with 縁 (えん, connection).
Learn 尊敬 そんけい (respect). とうとい is a formal word.
Learn お祝い (celebration, gift) and 祝日 (public holiday).
柔らかい やわらかい (soft) and 柔道 (judo) are the words to know. 軟らかい has the same reading.
Not needed for N4. You will see 殿 as どの after names in formal letters.
濃い こい (strong, thick, dark) is the word to know: 濃いコーヒー.
Only えき. It looks like 夜 (night) with the water part on the left.
い in 衣服 (clothes) is most useful. 浴衣 is a special reading: ゆかた.
Learn かた (shoulder). Do not confuse it with 方 (かた, person/way), same sound.
In daily talk people say ゼロ or れい for zero. 零下 means below zero.
Learn 幼稚園 ようちえん (kindergarten). Do not mix up 幼 with 幻 (illusion).
荷物 にもつ (luggage) is a key N4 word. Do not mix up 荷 with 何 (なに).
Learn 泊まる (stay the night): not 止まる (stop). はく changes: 一泊 いっぱく, 三泊 さんぱく.
き in 黄色 きいろ (yellow) is the N5 word. The on readings are for harder words.
甘い あまい (sweet) is the key word. 甘える means to act spoiled or rely on someone.
Learn 大臣 だいじん (minister): note じん, not しん.
浅い あさい (shallow) is the word to know. Opposite: 深い ふかい.
掃除 そうじ (cleaning) is an N5 word. Do not mix up 掃 with 帰 (かえる).
くも (cloud) matters most. In compounds it can become ぐも: 雨雲 あまぐも.
掘る ほる (dig) is the word to know. Do not mix up 掘 with 堀 (moat).
捨てる すてる (throw away) is a key N4 word. Do not mix up 捨 with 拾 (pick up).
Not needed for N4. 柔らかい is the more common spelling of やわらかい.
沈む しずむ (sink) is the word to know. Do not confuse with 静か (しずか, quiet).
冷凍 れいとう (frozen) is common on food packs. 凍る こおる sounds like 氷 こおり (ice).
Learn 牛乳 ぎゅうにゅう (milk). にゅう is the reading you will meet most.
Learn 恋人 こいびと (boyfriend or girlfriend). Do not mix up 恋 with 変 (へん, strange).
紅茶 こうちゃ is black tea (not red tea). 紅葉 is usually read もみじ or こうよう (autumn leaves).
Only こう, almost always in 郊外 (suburbs).
Learn こし (lower back, hips). Do not mix up 腰 with 要 (よう, need).
Not needed for N4. 炭酸 (carbonated) is useful for drinks.
踊る おどる (dance) is the word to know. Do not mix up 踊 with 通 (つう).
冊 counts books: 一冊 いっさつ, 二冊 にさつ, 三冊 さんさつ.
Learn 勇気 ゆうき (courage).
Only かい, in 機械 きかい (machine). Trap: 機会 (chance) is also きかい.
野菜 やさい (vegetable) is an N5 word. Do not mix up 菜 with 採 (pick).
珍しい めずらしい (rare, unusual) is the word to know.
Learn たまご (egg). らん is for harder words.
Alone it is みずうみ (lake). In names it is こ: 琵琶湖 びわこ.
Learn 喫茶店 きっさてん (cafe): きつ becomes きっ. 喫煙 means smoking.
干す ほす (hang out to dry) is useful. Do not mix up 干 with 千 (thousand).
むし (insect, bug) is the key word. 虫歯 is a tooth cavity.
Learn 印刷 いんさつ (printing). Do not confuse with 冊 (さつ), same sound.
お湯 おゆ is hot water; 水 みず is cold water. Do not mix up 湯 with 場 (ば).
溶ける とける (melt, dissolve) is the word to know. Do not mix up 溶 with 浴 (bathe).
Not needed for N4. Only こう, meaning ore or mineral.
Learn なみだ (tears). The on reading is rare.
匹 counts small animals and the sound changes: 一匹 いっぴき, 三匹 さんびき, 二匹 にひき.
Learn まご (grandchild). Do not mix up 孫 with 係 (かかり).
鋭い するどい (sharp) is the word to know.
Learn えだ (branch). Do not mix up 枝 with 技 (ぎ, skill).
塗る ぬる (paint, spread) is the word to know: パンにバターを塗る.

words.en: edge of the eaves, front of a house

kanji.tip: 軒 counts houses: 一軒 いっけん, 三軒 さんげん (けん becomes げん).
Only どく. 気の毒 means "what a pity", not poison.
叫ぶ さけぶ (shout) is the word to know.

words.en: visit to a shrine or temple

kanji.tip: Learn 拝見 はいけん, humble keigo for 見る (N4 keigo). はい becomes ぱい in 参拝.
こおり (ice) matters most. Do not mix up 氷 with 水 (water): 氷 has an extra dot.
Learn 乾杯 かんぱい (cheers) and 乾く (dry). Throat thirst is 渇く, not 乾く.
Only ぼう. 泥棒 どろぼう (thief) is a common word.
祈る いのる (pray, wish) is the word to know.
拾う ひろう (pick up) is an N4 word. Opposite: 捨てる (throw away), which looks similar.
こな (powder) matters most. It becomes こ in 小麦粉 (flour). Ignore the odd デシメートル reading.
Learn いと (thread). Do not confuse with 系 (けい, system).
めん is the useful one: 綿 on clothes labels means cotton. Do not mix up 綿 with 線 (せん, line).
Learn あせ (sweat). Do not mix up 汗 with 汚 (dirty).
Only どう matters, as in 銅メダル (bronze medal). Don't mix 銅 up with 同 (same), also どう.
湿度 (humidity) is in weather reports. Sound change: 湿気 is しっけ.
瓶 びん is a glass bottle, often written in kana. 花瓶 (vase) is the other common word.
咲く is the N4 word: 花が咲く (flowers bloom). さき can become ざき after another word, like 遅咲き.
召し上がる is keigo for 食べる and 飲む, and it is in N4: どうぞ召し上がってください.
Only かん matters. Easy hook: 缶 かん sounds like English can.
Not needed for N5/N4. 隻 counts ships, mostly in news. Sound change: 一隻 is いっせき.
脂 and 油 are both あぶら: 脂 is animal fat, 油 is oil. 脂肪 (body fat) is the main し word.
蒸し暑い (hot and humid) is the most useful word, perfect for Japanese summers.
Only はだ matters: 肌 is skin. 鳥肌 (goosebumps) is literally bird skin.
Not needed for N5/N4. 耕す (to plow a field) is the word to know.
鈍い means dull or slow to react. 鈍感 (not sensitive) is the opposite of 敏感.
泥棒 (thief) is the useful word, and it uses どろ (mud).
Only すみ matters. 隅 is the inside corner of a room; 角 かど is an outside corner, like a street corner.
とう is the reading you will meet: 電灯 (electric light). 灯 has 火 (fire) on the left: a light.
辛い can be からい (spicy) or つらい (painful), so read the context. からい is the N4 word.
磨く is the N4 word: 歯を磨く (brush your teeth). Don't mix 磨 up with 麻 or 魔.
むぎ is the reading you need: 麦茶 is the cold barley tea drunk in Japanese summers.
姓 is the family name on forms; in speech people say 名字 みょうじ. Don't confuse 姓 with 性, also せい.
封筒 (envelope) is the N4 word. The other words are rare at this level.
Learn 鼻 はな (nose). Trap: 花 (flower) is also はな.
Only つぶ matters: 粒 is a small round thing like a grain of rice. It also counts them: 一粒, 二粒.
Learn 名詞, 動詞 and 形容詞 now: grammar books use them a lot. Trap: 名詞 (noun) sounds like 名刺 (business card).
Only い matters. 胃が痛い (my stomach hurts) is a useful phrase at the doctor.

words.en: four and a half mat room

kanji.tip: 畳む (to fold) and 畳 (tatami) are the useful words. じょう counts mats for room size: 六畳 is about 10 square meters.
机 つくえ (desk) is an N5 word. The on reading き is rare.
皮膚 (skin) is the word to know. In daily talk people often say 肌 はだ for skin.
洗濯 (laundry) is an N4 word: 洗濯します. 濯 is almost only used in 洗濯.
Only とう matters. 塔 is a tower, like the 五重塔 (five storey pagoda) at temples.
お湯を沸かす means to boil water. 沸く (it boils) vs 沸かす (I boil it). Sound change: 沸騰 is ふっとう.
灰色 はいいろ (gray) is the most useful word. Sound change: 石灰 is せっかい.
お菓子 (snacks) is an N5 word. か becomes が in 和菓子.
帽子 ぼうし (hat) is the N5 word. Don't confuse 帽 with 冒 (risk), also ぼう.
枯れる (plants wither) is the useful word. Memory: 木 (tree) + 古 (old) = a withered tree.
涼しい (cool) is an N5 word for nice cool weather. Cold weather is 寒い.
舟 is a small boat; 船 (also ふね) is the usual word for ships. ふね often becomes ぶね after a word, like 小舟.
Only かい matters. 貝 is inside money kanji like 買う (buy): long ago, shells were money.
切符 きっぷ (ticket) is an N5 word. Sound change: ふ becomes ぷ in 切符.
Not needed for N4. Trap: にくい after a verb (読みにくい, hard to read) is written in kana, not 憎い.
皿 さら (plate) is an N5 word. After another word it often becomes ざら: 灰皿 はいざら.
Not needed for N5/N4. 肯定 (saying yes) is the opposite of 否定 (saying no).
Only 乾燥 (dry) matters, often in weather news. Trap: 乾燥 sounds like 感想 (opinion).
Not needed for N5/N4. Don't confuse 畜 with 蓄 (store up), also ちく.
挟む (put between) vs 挟まる (be caught): パンにハムを挟む, ドアに挟まる.
曇り くもり (cloudy) is an N5 weather word. Memory: 日 (sun) over 雲 (cloud).
Not needed for N5/N4. Don't confuse 滴 with 適 (suitable), also てき.
伺う is humble keigo for 聞く and 行く, in N4: お伺いします. Don't confuse 伺 with 何 (what).
You only need せい, mostly in 政治 (politics).
会議 (meeting) is the key word. Don't mix 議 up with 義 or 儀, which look similar.
みん is the reading you will meet, always in compounds like 国民.
連れて行く / 連れて来る (take someone / bring someone) and 連絡 matter most. Use 連れる for people and animals, 持って行く for things.
たい is the only reading you need. 反対 (against) is the common word; 絶対 has ぜっ from 絶, not from 対.
Learn 全部 ぜんぶ and 部屋 へや. Trap: 部屋 is read へや, not ぶや.
合う (to fit) and 場合, 試合 matter most. Trap: 会う (meet people) is a different kanji from 合う (fit, match).
し is for city (市役所), いち for markets (市場). 市場 can also be read しじょう (the money market).
案内 (guide) is the key N4 word. Don't confuse 内 with 肉 (meat), which looks similar.
相談 (asking advice) is the key N4 word, then 相手. しょう is mostly in 首相.
予定 (plan) is the word to know. てい is by far the most common reading.
かい counts times. Watch the sound change: 一回 いっかい, 六回 ろっかい.
選ぶ (to choose) is the N4 word. 選択 (choice) sounds like 洗濯 (laundry): both せんたく.
こめ (rice) is the one for N5/N4. べい means America in news words. Cooked rice is ご飯, not 米.
実は (actually) is very common in speech. Sound change: 実際 is じっさい.
かん is the reading you need: 関係 and 玄関 (front door area).
決める (I decide) vs 決まる (it is decided): learn both. けつ often becomes けっ, as in 決心.
全部 and 全然 are must-know words. 全然 is usually used with a negative: 全然わかりません.
Alone, 表 can be ひょう (chart) or おもて (front side). Sound change: 発表 はっぴょう.
戦争 (war) and 戦う (to fight) are the ones to know.
経験 (experience) is the key word. 経つ (time passes) sounds like 立つ (stand) but is written differently.
最近, 最初, 最後 are all common at N4. 最寄り駅 (nearest station) has a special reading.
げん is the main reading. 現れる (appear) and 表れる (show, be expressed) are both あらわれる; 現れる is for things you can see.
調べる (look up, check) is the N4 word. 調子 is common in 調子がいい (going well).

words.en: to change shape, to disguise oneself

kanji.tip: か (文化) matters most. Trap: 化学 (chemistry) and 科学 (science) are both かがく.
本当 and 弁当 are must-know N5/N4 words. 当たる also means to win: 宝くじが当たる.
Only やく matters: 約束 (promise) and 予約 (booking).
くび (neck) is the everyday word. 首 also means getting fired: 首になる.
ほう is the reading you need. Sound change: 文法 is ぶんぽう.
せい is the main reading: 女性, 男性. Don't confuse 性 with 姓 (family name), also せい.
必要 and 要る (to need) are the key words. 要る sounds the same as いる (to be), so use context.
Only せい: 制服 (school uniform) is the easiest word.
治る is for illness; 直る is for fixing things. Both are なおる, so check the meaning.

words.en: to serve as, to play a role

kanji.tip: む is the reading you'll meet, as in 事務所. 務める, 勤める and 努める are all つとめる, with different meanings.
せい is the main reading. 賛成 (agree) is the opposite of 反対 (against).
Only き matters. Sound change: 学期 is がっき.
取る (take) is the N4 word. Taking a photo is 撮る, a different kanji with the same reading.
と is the main reading, as in 京都. Trap: 都合 (convenience) is read つごう.
わ means Japanese style (和食, 和室) or peace (平和).
飛行機 (airplane) is the N5 word. Trap: 機会 (chance) and 機械 (machine) are both きかい.
平仮名 ひらがな and 平日 へいじつ are the useful ones. 平等 (equality) is a trap: びょうどう.
参加 (take part) is the key word: 参加します.
受ける (試験を受ける, take a test) and 受付 (reception) are the useful ones. 受付 is usually written without け.
続く (it continues) vs 続ける (I keep doing): verb stem + 続ける means keep doing, like 読み続ける.
進む (go forward) is the main word. In 進歩 しんぽ, 歩 changes from ほ to ぽ.
数学 (maths) and 数える (count) are useful. Sound change: 人数 is にんずう.
Only き matters. Sound change: 日記 is にっき.
初めて (first time) and 最初 are key. Trap: 初めまして uses 初, but 始める (to start) uses 始.
指 ゆび (finger) is the everyday word. 指定席 していせき is a reserved seat on a train.
Only けん matters, mostly in 権利 (a right).
し is the main reading: 支払い (payment) is common in shops.
Learn お土産 おみやげ for N4: a special reading. 産む (give birth) and 生む are both うむ.
Only てん matters: 点 is a point or a test score. 100点 is ひゃくてん.
Only ほう matters: 天気予報 (weather forecast) is the useful word.

words.en: to be finished, to be settled

kanji.tip: 済む (be over) is useful. Sound changes: 経済 けいざい, and 済み becomes ずみ after a word.
Only かつ matters: 生活 (life, living) is the key word.
げん (原因, cause) is the most useful. Don't confuse 原 with 源 (source) or 願 (wish).
共通 and 共に are the useful words. Trap: 子供 uses 供, not 共.
得意 (good at) is the key word: 料理が得意です. Its opposite is 苦手.
かい is the main reading: 理解 and 正解. 問題を解く means to solve a problem.
こう is the reading you need: 交番 (police box) and 交通 (traffic).
Only し matters: 資料 (handouts, documents) is common at work and school.
Only よ matters. 予 means beforehand: 予定, 予約, 予習.
向こう (over there) is the N4 word. こう appears in compounds like 方向.
さい is the main reading: 国際 and 実際. きわ becomes ぎわ after a word, as in 窓際.
勝つ (to win) is the key word; its opposite is 負ける. Sound change: 勝手 is かって.
面白い おもしろい is the must-know N5 word. Other words use めん.
こく is the reading you'll meet: 報告 and 広告.
Only はん matters at this level. 反対 (against) is the opposite of 賛成 (agree).
Both はん and ばん are real readings. 判子 はんこ (name stamp) is useful in Japan.
確認 (checking) is common in daily life: 確認してください.
参ります is humble keigo for 行きます / 来ます, useful for N4. 参加 is the main さん word.
Only り matters: 便利 (convenient) is an N5 word. Its opposite is 不便.

words.en: to put together, to team up

kanji.tip: 番組 (TV show) is the key N4 word. Sound change: くみ becomes ぐみ after a word, as in 番組.
Only しん matters: 信号 (traffic light) and 信じる (believe). 自信 (confidence) sounds like 地震 (earthquake).
Only ざい matters, in words like 現在. Don't confuse 在 with 存 or 有.
Only けん matters: 事件 (incident) is common in the news.
After another word, かわ almost always becomes がわ: 右側, 左側.
責任 (responsibility) and 任せる (leave it to someone) are useful: 私に任せて.
引く has many uses: 風邪を引く (catch a cold). Playing piano is 弾く, also ひく but a different kanji.

words.en: to ask for, to look for

kanji.tip: Learn もとめる first. Do not mix up 求 with 球 (ball) and 救 (save), which also read きゅう.
ところ alone and しょ in words like 住所 are both key. ところ becomes どころ in 台所, and しょ becomes じょ in 近所.
つぎ (next) is the one you need now. In compounds it is usually じ.
昨日 is read きのう, a special reading you need at N5. In other words 昨 is さく.
Only one reading: ろん. Do not mix up 論 with 輪 (ring) or 倫, which look similar.
Only one reading: かん. 官 is the right part of 館 (building), which is also かん.
ふえる (go up) and ふやす (make more) matter most for N4. Watch the pair: ふえる has no object, ふやす has one.
関係 かんけい is the most useful word. 係 alone is かかり.
Only one reading: かん. 感じる is the verb to learn first.
Mostly じょう, as in 情報. Do not confuse 情 with 晴 (clear weather) or 清, which read せい.
なげる (throw) is the main word. In compounds it is とう.
しめす is the verb. In 指示 しじ, 示 is じ, not し.
へん (strange) and 大変 are N4 words. かわる/かえる: be careful, 代わる and 換える sound the same.
うつ (hit, type) is the one to know. Note 打つ, 撃つ (shoot) and 討つ all read うつ.
なおす (fix) matters most. Trap: 正直 is しょうじき, not しょうちょく.
Only one reading you need: りょう. 両親 is an N4 word.
Only one reading: しき. Do not confuse 式 with 試 (test), which is し.
たしか and たしかめる are the useful ones. 正確 (accurate) and 性格 (personality) both read せいかく.
果物 くだもの is a special reading you need at N5. Otherwise か, as in 結果.
Only one reading you need: よう. Words with 容 are mostly N3 and above.
必要 ひつよう is the key N4 word. ひつ becomes ひっ in 必死.
Only one reading: えん. Not needed much before N3.
さい for ages (五歳 ごさい) is what you need at N5. Trap: 20 years old is はたち, and 一歳 is いっさい.
Mostly そう, as in 戦争. あらそう is the verb.
Only one reading: だん. 相談 is an N4 word.
Only one reading you need: のう. Do not confuse 能 with 熊 (bear).
くらい/ぐらい (about) is used at N5, but usually in hiragana. In compounds 位 is い.
おく (put) is the N4 word, also in ～ておく (do in advance).
ながれる and ながす are a pair (no object / with object). In compounds 流 is りゅう.
Only one reading you need: かく. 合格 is the word you want in December!
Not needed much at N4. Do not confuse 疑 with 凝 (stiff).

words.en: to pass, to be too much

kanji.tip: すぎる is very useful at N4: 食べすぎる (eat too much). すごす is spend time.
Only one reading you need: きょく. 郵便局 is an N4 word.
Mostly ほう, as in 放送. Trap: 放す (let go) and 話す (speak) both read はなす.
Mostly じょう. 非常に (very) is common in formal Japanese.
Only one reading: じょう. Words with 状 are mostly N3 and above.
Mostly きゅう, as in 野球. 求 and 救 look similar and also read きゅう.
Only one reading you need: しょく. Do not confuse 職 with 織 or 識, which look similar.
Not needed much at N4. あたえる is a formal word for give.
子供 こども is the N5 word: とも becomes ども in it. In compounds 供 is きょう.
やく is the reading you need. 役に立つ (useful) is an N4 phrase.

words.en: to get ready, to set up

kanji.tip: 結構 けっこう is the N4 word. かまいません means I do not mind.
Mostly the kun readings: わる, われる, 割引. かつ is rare.
ひ is the reading you need. Do not confuse 費 with 貴 (precious), which is き.
つ is the key reading: 気をつける, 受付. It becomes づ in 片付ける.
理由 (reason) and 自由 (free) both use ゆう. Do not confuse 由 with 田 or 曲.
せつ is the reading you need: 説明 and 小説 are N4 words.
むずかしい is the N5/N4 word. かた becomes がた in ありがたい (where ありがとう comes from).
やさしい (kind) is the N4 word. Trap: 易しい (easy) also reads やさしい.
大丈夫 だいじょうぶ (ぶ) is the most useful word. 夫 alone is おっと. Do not confuse 夫 with 天 (sky).
Mostly しゅう. Not needed much at N4.
ことわる (refuse) is the useful verb. In compounds 断 is だん.
いし (stone) alone is what you need first. Do not confuse 石 with 右 (right).
ちがう is an N5/N4 word. In 間違える, 違 is still ちが.
けす (turn off) and きえる (go out) are a pair. Note the readings change: け for the verb with an object, き without.
かみ (god) and 神社 じんじゃ are the useful ones. Trap: 紙 (paper) and 髪 (hair) also read かみ.
Only one reading you need: ばん. 一番 and 番号 are N5/N4 words.
Only one reading: き, which becomes ぎ in 定規.
Only one reading you need: じゅつ. Do not confuse 術 with 述, also じゅつ.
準備 じゅんび is the N4 word. そなえる sounds like 供える (offer).
Only one reading: たく. Do not confuse 宅 with 字 (letter).
Only one reading: がい. Mostly N3 and above.
心配 しんぱい is the N4 word: はい becomes ぱい in it.
Only one reading you need: けい. Do not confuse 警 with 驚 (surprise) or 敬 (respect).
そだてる and そだつ are a pair (with object / no object). In compounds 育 is いく.
Only one reading: せき. Do not confuse 席 with 度 or 庭, which look similar.
たずねる (visit) is the useful one. Trap: 尋ねる (to ask) also reads たずねる.

words.en: to give a ride, to put on

kanji.tip: のる is an N5 word. Say 電車に乗る (use に, not を).
残念 ざんねん is the N4 word. のこる and のこす are a pair (no object / with object).
Mostly そう. Do not confuse 想 with 相 (the top part), which is also そう.
こえ (voice) is the N4 word. It becomes ごえ in 大声. Trap: an animal's voice is also こえ, not おと.
Only one reading: ねん. 残念 is an N4 word.

words.en: to be saved, to be a help

kanji.tip: たすける and たすかる are a pair. たすかります means that helps a lot.
Only one reading you need: ろう. Do not confuse 労 with 栄 or 営, which look similar.
たとえば (for example) is very useful. 例 alone is れい.
ぜん is the reading you need: 全然 is an N4 word. ねん is rare.
Not needed much at N4. Do not confuse 限 with 根 (root) or 眼 (eye).
おう (chase) is the verb. In compounds 追 is つい.
Only one reading you need: しょう. Do not confuse 商 with 適 or 滴, which have a similar part.
言葉 ことば is the N4 word: は becomes ば in it. 紅葉 can also be read もみじ.

words.en: to be passed on, get across

kanji.tip: {手伝|てつだ}う (to help) is the N4 word: here つた changes to つだ. Later learn {伝|つた}える (to tell, pass on).
{働|はたら}く (to work) is the word to know. It is {動|うご}く (to move) with a person on the left: do not mix them up.
Learn {形|かたち} (shape) and {人形|にんぎょう} (doll). In {人形|にんぎょう} it reads ぎょう, not けい.
{景色|けしき} (scenery, view) is the N4 word, and it is a special reading: け, not けい.
{落|お}ちる (to fall) and {落|お}とす (to drop) are N4. ちる happens by itself, とす is something you do.
{好|す}き (like) and {大好|だいす}き (love) are N5. Note: {好|す}き is a な adjective, not a verb.
Learn {退院|たいいん} (leave hospital), the opposite of {入院|にゅういん}. Do not mix {退|たい} with {追|お}う (to chase), which looks similar.

words.en: the front, the head (of a line)

kanji.tip: {頭|あたま} (head) is N5. ず appears in {頭痛|ずつう} (headache); とう is the counter for big animals.
{負|ま}ける (to lose) is N4, the opposite of {勝|か}つ. In {勝負|しょうぶ} ふ changes to ぶ.
{渡|わた}る (to cross) and {渡|わた}す (to hand over) are the key words. It is {度|ど} with water on the left.
{失礼|しつれい}します (excuse me) is N4. In {失敗|しっぱい} (failure) しつ changes to しっ.
{差|さ}し{上|あ}げる (to give, humble) is N4. {傘|かさ}を{差|さ}す means to put up an umbrella.
{週末|しゅうまつ} (weekend) is the useful word. Trap: {末|まつ} has a long top line, {未|み} has a short one.

words.en: to protect, keep (a promise, a rule)

kanji.tip: {守|まも}る (to protect, keep a rule) and {留守|るす} (being out, not at home) are N4. In {留守|るす} it reads す.
{若|わか}い (young) is N4. Do not mix {若|わか} with {苦|くる}しい: both have grass on top.
{種類|しゅるい} (kind, type) is the key word. Alone it is {種|たね} (seed).
{美|うつく}しい (beautiful) and {美術館|びじゅつかん} (art museum) are N4. おいしい can be written {美味|おい}しい, a special reading.

words.w: {一生懸命|いっしょうけんめい}

kanji.tip: {一生懸命|いっしょうけんめい} (as hard as you can) is the N4 word. Alone, it is {命|いのち} (life).
Learn {幸福|こうふく} (happiness). Do not mix with {副|ふく} (vice, sub), which has the same sound and a similar part.
{希望|きぼう} (hope, wish) is the word you will see most. The kun word is {望|のぞ}む (to wish for).
{是非|ぜひ} (by all means) is N4, often written in kana. {非|ひ} means not: {非常口|ひじょうぐち} is the emergency exit.
Learn {観光|かんこう} (sightseeing). Do not mix it with {歓迎|かんげい} (welcome), which has a similar left side.
{警察|けいさつ} (police) is N4. The top is a roof and the bottom is {祭|まつ}り (festival).
{階段|かいだん} (stairs) and {値段|ねだん} (price) are both N4 and both read だん.
{横|よこ} (side, next to) is N5: {机|つくえ}の{横|よこ}. おう appears in {横断歩道|おうだんほどう} (pedestrian crossing).
{深|ふか}い (deep) is the word to know. After another word it can become ぶか: {興味深|きょうみぶか}い.

words.w: {申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ありません

kanji.tip: {申|もう}す and {申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ありません (I am very sorry) are N4 polite speech. {申|しん} looks like {田|た} with a line through it.
{様|さま} is a very polite さん: お{客様|きゃくさま}, {皆様|みなさま}. よう appears in {様子|ようす} (look, state).
{財布|さいふ} (wallet) is N4, and here it reads さい, not ざい.
{空港|くうこう} (airport) is N4: sky + port. Alone it is {港|みなと}.
Learn {知識|ちしき} (knowledge). Do not mix it with {職|しょく} (job), which has the same right side.
{呼|よ}ぶ (to call, to invite) is N4. こ is only in harder words like {呼吸|こきゅう}.
{友達|ともだち} (friend) is N5: here たち changes to だち. たち also means more than one person: {私達|わたしたち} (we).
{良|よ}い means good. いい is normally written in kana; {良|よ}い is the more formal, written form.
Learn {気候|きこう} (climate). Do not confuse it with {侯|こう} (lord), which has no thin line in the middle.
ほど (about, to the extent) is usually written in kana. Learn {程度|ていど} (level, degree) and {先程|さきほど} (a while ago).
{満員|まんいん} (full of people, like a crowded train) is the useful word. {満足|まんぞく} means satisfied.
{失敗|しっぱい} (failure, mistake) is the key word: here はい changes to ぱい.
{値段|ねだん} (price) is N4. ち appears in {価値|かち} (value).

words.en: end of a street, T junction

kanji.tip: {突然|とつぜん} (suddenly) is the word you will see most. In {突|つ}き{当|あ}たり (end of the street) it reads つ.
{光|ひかり} (light) and {光|ひか}る (to shine). こう appears in {観光|かんこう} (sightseeing).
Learn {道路|どうろ} (road). For everyday talk, {道|みち} is the easy word for road.
{科学|かがく} (science) and {教科書|きょうかしょ} (textbook). Do not mix with {料理|りょうり}: {料|りょう} has rice on the left, {科|か} has grain.
Learn {面積|めんせき} (area) and {積極的|せっきょくてき} (active, here せき changes to せっ). つもり (intention) comes from {積|つ}もる but is written in kana.
{他|ほか} (other) is N4. In words like {他人|たにん} (stranger) it reads た.
Mostly in harder words like {処理|しょり}. ところ (place) is written {所|ところ} today, not {処|しょ}.
{太|ふと}い (thick) and {太|ふと}る (to gain weight) are N4. Trap: {太|たい} has a dot under the cross, {犬|いぬ} has it top right, {大|おお}きい has none.
{客|きゃく} (guest, customer) is N4, often heard as お{客|きゃく}さん or お{客様|きゃくさま}.
Mostly in harder words: {否定|ひてい} (denial), {拒否|きょひ} (refusal). The top is {不|ふ} (not) over a mouth: saying no.
Learn {教師|きょうし} (teacher) and {医師|いし} (doctor). {教師|きょうし} is the job; you call a teacher {先生|せんせい}.
{山|やま}に{登|のぼ}る (climb a mountain) is N4. In {登山|とざん} (mountain climbing) it reads と.
{易|やさ}しい means easy, {優|やさ}しい means kind: same sound, different kanji.
{速|はや}い (fast) vs {早|はや}い (early): same sound, different kanji. In {早速|さっそく} (right away) it reads そく.
ご{存|ぞん}じですか (do you know? polite) is N4 polite speech. そん appears in {存在|そんざい} (existence).
{飛行機|ひこうき} (airplane) is N5 and {飛|と}ぶ (to fly) is N4.
{殺|ころ}す (to kill) is the basic word. さつ appears in news words like {殺人|さつじん} (murder).
{番号|ばんごう} (number) and {信号|しんごう} (traffic light) are N4 and both read ごう.
{簡単|かんたん} (easy, simple) is N4, and {単語|たんご} (word, vocabulary) is a great word for learners.
{座|すわ}る (to sit) is N5. ざ appears in {座席|ざせき} (seat) and {口座|こうざ} (bank account).

words.en: to tear, break (a rule, a promise)

kanji.tip: {破|やぶ}る (to tear, break a rule) and {破|やぶ}れる (to get torn). Trap: {敗|やぶ}れる (to be defeated) has the same sound.
{掃除|そうじ} (cleaning) is N4, and here it reads じ, not じょ.
Learn {完全|かんぜん} (complete) and {完成|かんせい} (completion). Under the roof is {元|げん} from {元気|げんき}.

words.en: to get off (a train, a bus)

kanji.tip: {雨|あめ}が{降|ふ}る (rain falls) and {電車|でんしゃ}を{降|お}りる (get off a train) are both N5. Same kanji, different reading.
{責任|せきにん} (responsibility) is the key word. The same shape is inside {積|つ}む (to pile up).
{捕|つか}まえる (to catch) is the useful word. つか is not in every list, but it is the common reading.
{危|あぶ}ない (dangerous, watch out!) is N4. {危険|きけん} is the written word you see on signs.
{給料|きゅうりょう} (salary) and {時給|じきゅう} (pay per hour) are useful for part time jobs.
{苦手|にがて} (bad at, do not like) is N4: にが is common even if lists skip it. {苦|にが}い is bitter, {苦|くる}しい is painful.
{迎|むか}えに{行|い}く (go to pick someone up) is very useful. げい appears in {歓迎|かんげい} (welcome).
{公園|こうえん} (park) is N5. Trap: {遠|とお}い (far) has the same inner part, but {園|えん} is inside a box.
{道具|どうぐ} (tool) is N4. {具合|ぐあい}が{悪|わる}い means feeling unwell.
{辞書|じしょ} (dictionary) is N4. {辞|や}める is to quit a job; for stopping other things use {止|や}める.
{原因|げんいん} (cause) is the word to know. Trap: {因|いん} has {大|だい} in a box, {困|こま}る has {木|き} in a box.
{馬|うま} (horse). バカ (fool) can be written {馬鹿|ばか}: horse + deer.
{愛|あい} (love). かわいい is sometimes written {可愛|かわい}い, a special reading.
You will see {富|ふ} most in {富士山|ふじさん} (Mount Fuji). Do not mix it with {福|ふく} (good luck).
{彼|かれ} (he) and {彼女|かのじょ} (she) are N4. They also mean boyfriend and girlfriend.
{未来|みらい} (future). Trap: {未|み} has a short top line, {末|すえ} has a long one.
Learn お{見舞|みま}い (visiting someone who is ill). ぶ appears in {舞台|ぶたい} (stage) and {歌舞伎|かぶき}.
{亡|な}くなる is a polite way to say to die. Trap: {無|な}くなる (to run out, be lost) has the same sound.
At N5/N4 learn つめたい: cold to the touch (water, drinks). Trap: cold weather is さむい ({寒|さむ}い), not つめたい.
Only てき matters. {適当|てきとう} can mean suitable, but in speech it often means careless.
Only ふ matters. In {夫婦|ふうふ} the first kanji is ふう, the second is ふ.
よる (drop by) is the useful one: コンビニに{寄|よ}る. Do not mix it up with {夜|よる} (night).
No on reading. こ often becomes ご after another word: {人込|ひとご}み.
For N5/N4 you need かお. It becomes がお after another word: {笑顔|えがお}.
Only るい matters. {種類|しゅるい} (kind, type) is the word to know first.
あまり is the key N4 word: あまり{好|す}きじゃない (I don't like it much). In speech it is often あんまり.
Only おう matters. Trap: {女王|じょおう} is じょおう, not じょうおう. Do not confuse {王|おう} with {玉|たま} (ball).
Learn かえす (give back) and {返事|へんじ}. Trap: {帰|かえ}る means go home, a different kanji.

words.en: husband and wife, Mr and Mrs

kanji.tip: Learn つま: your own wife. For someone else's wife say {奥|おく}さん.
Learn {背|せ}が{高|たか}い (tall), also said せいがたかい. {背中|せなか} is your back.
Trap: three あつい. {熱|あつ}い is hot things (soup), {暑|あつ}い is hot weather, {厚|あつ}い is thick. ねつ becomes ねっ in {熱心|ねっしん}.
{宿題|しゅくだい} is the N4 word. In the place name {新宿|しんじゅく} it becomes じゅく.
Learn くすり and {薬|くすり}を{飲|の}む (take medicine, literally drink). くすり becomes ぐすり in {目薬|めぐすり}.
Learn {危険|きけん} (danger), seen on signs. Do not confuse with {試験|しけん} (exam) or {検査|けんさ} (test).
たのむ is the N4 word: ask a favour or order food. Do not mix up たのむ and たよる.
おぼえる is the N4 word. さ becomes ざ in {目覚|めざ}まし.
Learn ふね. It becomes ふな before some words, like {船便|ふなびん}. {舟|ふね} is also ふね (small boat).
Only と matters. {途中|とちゅう} (on the way) is the word to learn: {帰|かえ}る{途中|とちゅう}.
Learn ゆるす: it means both allow and forgive. {免許|めんきょ} is a driving licence.

words.en: to come out, to fall out

kanji.tip: Learn ぬく and ぬける (a tooth comes out). Not needed much for N4.
Two on readings: べん in {便利|べんり}, びん in {郵便|ゆうびん}. Learn both, they are both N5/N4.
Learn {留学|りゅうがく} (りゅう) and {留守|るす} (る): same kanji, different readings. Do not confuse it with the top of {貿易|ぼうえき} (trade).
Not needed for N4. つみ alone, ざい in compounds like {犯罪|はんざい}.
Learn {努力|どりょく} (effort). Trap: {努|つと}める, {勤|つと}める and {務|つと}める are all つとめる with different meanings.
Not needed for N4. Only せい is common. Do not confuse with {情|じょう} (feeling) or {清|せい} (pure).
Learn {散歩|さんぽ} (a walk): {散歩|さんぽ}する. ほ becomes ぽ here, in the second kanji.
しずか is N5: {静|しず}かな{部屋|へや}. It is a な adjective.
Only こん. Learn {結婚|けっこん}する (to get married); the first kanji becomes けっ here.

words.en: to be happy, to be glad

kanji.tip: Learn よろこぶ. {喜|よろこ}んで means gladly: {喜|よろこ}んで{手伝|てつだ}います.

words.en: to float up; to come to mind

kanji.tip: Not needed for N4. う in {浮|う}く and {浮|う}かぶ; {浮気|うわき} is a special whole word reading.
Learn {絶対|ぜったい}: ぜつ becomes ぜっ. {絶対|ぜったい}に{行|い}く = I will definitely go.
Learn しあわせ. Watch the okurigana: {幸|しあわ}せ is しあわせ, {幸|さいわ}い is さいわい.
Learn おす (push, press a button). Signs on doors: {押|お}す (push) and {引|ひ}く (pull).
Learn たおれる. とう becomes どう in {面倒|めんどう}, a common word for a hassle.

words.w: {高等学校|こうとうがっこう}

kanji.tip: など is usually written in kana. とう becomes どう in {平等|びょうどう}. Do not confuse with {待|ま}つ or {特|とく}.
Not needed much for N4. Learn {老人|ろうじん}. Do not confuse with {考|かんが}える (think).
まがる is N4: {右|みぎ}に{曲|ま}がる (turn right). Alone it is {曲|きょく} (a song).
Learn はらう. はら becomes ばら after another word: {前払|まえばら}い.
Learn にわ (N4). Do not confuse {庭|にわ} with {店|みせ} (shop).
Learn {生徒|せいと} (school pupil). University students are {学生|がくせい}.
Learn {会社|かいしゃ}に{勤|つと}める (work for a company). Trap: {努|つと}める also reads つとめる but means try hard.
Both kun readings are N5/N4: おそい (slow, late) and おくれる (be late). Watch the okurigana to choose.
The verb いる is almost always written in kana, so you rarely see this kanji at N4. {居酒屋|いざかや} is a useful word.
Learn {雑誌|ざっし}: ざつ becomes ざっ. ぞう is only in a few words.

words.en: to invite; to wave someone over

kanji.tip: Learn {招待|しょうたい}する (to invite). Do not confuse with {紹介|しょうかい} (introduction).

words.en: to be in trouble, not know what to do

kanji.tip: こまる is N4: {困|こま}ったな (oh no, what do I do).

words.en: to be chipped, to be missing

kanji.tip: Learn {欠席|けっせき} (absence): けつ becomes けっ. Its opposite is {出席|しゅっせき}.
Not needed much for N4. Do not confuse it with {便|べん} in {便利|べんり}.
Learn {遅刻|ちこく} (being late) and {時刻表|じこくひょう} (timetable).
Only さん matters. {賛成|さんせい} (agree) is the opposite of {反対|はんたい} (disagree).

words.en: to hold in your arms, to hug
to carry in your arms; to have (problems)

kanji.tip: Not needed for N4. Trap: the same verb can be {抱|だ}く (hug) or {抱|いだ}く (hold a feeling).
Learn {犯人|はんにん} (criminal).
Not needed much for N4. Scary is usually written {怖|こわ}い, not with this kanji.
{息子|むすこ} (son) is the N4 word and a special reading. Daughter is {娘|むすめ}.
とおい is N5. Spelling trap: とおい, not とうい. {遠慮|えんりょ}しないで = please don't hold back.
Only もど matters. {戻|もど}る is going back to where you were; {帰|かえ}る is going home.
お{願|ねが}いします is N5 and you will use it every day. Do not confuse {願|ねが}う with {顔|かお} (face).
Learn え (N5). It looks like a kun reading but え is actually an on reading.
Learn {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}す (move house). こ becomes ご after a noun: {窓越|まどご}し.
ほしい is N5: {水|みず}が{欲|ほ}しい. For wanting to do something use たい, not ほしい.
いたい is N5: {頭|あたま}が{痛|いた}い (my head hurts). In {頭痛|ずつう} the first kanji is ず, not あたま.
Learn わらう. {笑顔|えがお} is a special reading worth knowing.
Learn お{互|たが}い (each other): お{互|たが}いに{助|たす}け{合|あ}う.
{約束|やくそく} is N4. Do not confuse {束|たば} with {東|ひがし} (east).
Learn {似|に}ている (look like): {母|はは}に{似|に}ている. {似合|にあ}う is used for clothes: よく{似合|にあ}う.
Only れつ matters. It becomes れっ in {列車|れっしゃ}. Do not confuse with {例|れい} (example).

words.en: to feel around for, to probe

kanji.tip: さがす is N4. Trap: {探|さが}す and {捜|さが}す are both さがす; {捜|さが}す is for lost things or people.

words.en: to let go, to let escape

kanji.tip: Learn にげる. Note the pair: {逃|に}げる (run away) and {逃|に}がす (let something escape).
あそぶ is N5. It means hanging out with friends too, not only children playing.

words.en: to get lost; to be unsure

kanji.tip: Learn {迷|まよ}う and {迷惑|めいわく}. Trap: {迷子|まいご} is a special reading, まいご, not めいご.
Learn ゆめ. Note: you see a dream, {夢|ゆめ}を{見|み}る.

words.en: you (casual, to someone close or younger)
name suffix for boys or juniors

kanji.tip: Both are N4. After a name it is くん ({田中|たなか}{君|くん}); alone it is きみ (you).
しめる and しまる are N5/N4. Trap: {閉|し}める (close a door) and {締|し}める (tie, fasten) are both しめる.
{一緒|いっしょ}に (together) is N5. The first kanji becomes いっ here.
Learn おる and おれる. {骨|ほね}を{折|お}る means to break a bone.
Learn くさ. Do not confuse {草|くさ} with {早|はや}い (early), which is its bottom half.
Learn くらす and {日|ひ}が{暮|く}れる (it gets dark). Do not confuse with {墓|はか} (grave).
Learn お{酒|さけ}. さけ becomes さか before some words, and ざか in {居酒屋|いざかや}.
For N4 you need かな in 悲しい. ひ appears in harder words like 悲鳴.
は is the key reading (晴れ, 晴れる). Trap: in 素晴らしい it changes sound to ば.
Only か matters. These words are very often written in kana (かける, 出かける, かかる).
Learn 到着 (arrival), seen at airports and stations. Do not mix it up with 倒 (fall), which looks similar.

words.en: to sleep, to go to bed

kanji.tip: ね in 寝る is the one you need now. 寝る means go to bed or lie down; 眠る means actually be asleep.

words.w: {暗証番号|あんしょうばんごう}

kanji.tip: 暗い (dark) is the opposite of 明るい (bright); both have 日 on the left. あん comes later, in 暗記.
For N4 learn 盗む. A thief is usually 泥棒 (どろぼう), which does not use this kanji.

words.en: to breathe in, to smoke, to suck

kanji.tip: す in 吸う is the key one (タバコを吸う: to smoke). Do not confuse 吸 with 級 (class), also read きゅう.
Learn よう in 太陽 (the sun). The right side looks like 場 and 湯, so check the left part.
This is the polite ご or お. Today it is usually written in hiragana (ご飯, お礼), so just recognise it on signs and letters.
は is the one to know (歯, 歯医者). Trap: it becomes ば in 虫歯.
わす in 忘れる is essential. Memory aid: 亡 (gone) on top of 心 (heart, mind).
For N5 and N4 you only need ゆき. せつ shows up in weather news, like 積雪.
Learn ふ in 吹く (風が吹く: the wind blows). 吹雪 (ふぶき) is a special whole-word reading.
Only むすめ is needed. Someone else's daughter is usually お嬢さん, a different kanji.
Learn 誤解. Trap: 誤る (make a mistake) and 謝る (apologise) are both あやまる; the common N4 one is 謝る.
Both readings matter at N4: あら in 洗う and せん in 洗濯.
Learn 慣れる (日本の生活に慣れる: get used to life in Japan) and 習慣.
れい is the only reading you need: 失礼します is a must-know phrase.
まど is the one you need. 窓口 (counter) is useful at banks and stations.
This kanji is almost always むかし. Its on readings are rare. Do not mix it up with 借 (borrow).
In daily talk 貧乏 (びんぼう) is the common word. Trap: びん in 貧乏 but ひん in 貧血.
Learn おこる. Trap: 怒る can be read おこる or いかる; in speech it is おこる.
およ in 泳ぐ is essential; 水泳 is the sport. Compare 永 (long) on the right.
そ is the only reading; it becomes ぞ in 先祖. Use 祖父 and 祖母 for your own grandparents, おじいさん and おばあさん for others.
はい is the counter for cups and bowls. Trap: the sound changes, いっぱい, にはい, さんばい.
Learn つか in 疲れる and the phrase お疲れ様です. ひ is for formal words like 疲労.
皆さん (みなさん) and みんな are what you need. みんな is usually written in hiragana.
な matters most. Trap: 鳴く is for animals and birds (口 + 鳥), 泣く is for people crying.
The everyday word is お腹 (おなか), a special reading. はら is rougher; ふく becomes ぷく in 満腹.
Learn 禁煙 (no smoking), seen on signs everywhere, and 煙 (けむり).
ねむ in 眠い is the key one. Do not mix up 眠る (be asleep) and 寝る (go to bed).
こわ in 怖い is what you need. Trap: こわい is also used for 恐い, but 怖い is the usual spelling.
Only みみ matters at N5 and N4. You can also spot 耳 inside 聞 (hear): an ear at the gate 門.
いただく is key for N4 polite speech, but it is often written in kana (いただきます).
Only はこ is needed. Trap: it becomes ばこ after another word, as in 筆箱.
ばん is the only reading, as in こんばんは (good evening). Do not confuse 晩 with 勉 (effort).
Learn 寒い. Trap: 寒い is for weather or air; for cold things you touch, use 冷たい.
かみ is the key reading. Trap: 髪 (hair) and 紙 (paper) are both かみ; かみ becomes がみ in 前髪.
Learn 忙しい (いそがしい). Memory aid: 忄 (heart) + 亡 (lost), compare 忘 (forget).
さい is the only reading. For ages, 才 is a simple way to write 歳; both are read さい.
Only くつ is needed. Trap: it becomes ぐつ in 長靴.
Learn 恥ずかしい (はずかしい). Memory aid: 耳 (ear) + 心 (heart), your ears go red.
Learn 偶然. たまに is usually written in hiragana.
Learn えら in 偉い. Do not confuse 偉 with 違 (different), which has the same right side.
Only ねこ is needed. The on reading びょう is very rare.
いく matters, but いくつ and いくら are almost always written in hiragana.
あう (meet) and かい (会社) matter most. 会う is for meeting people; 合う (to fit) is a different kanji.
おなじ is the key word for N5/N4. どう shows up in compounds like 同時.
じ (食事) and 仕事 are the big ones. こと becomes ごと after another word, as in 仕事.
じ is the main reading: 自分, 自転車. Watch 自然, which uses し instead.
しゃ is the reading to know: 会社, 社長. In 神社 (shrine) it changes to じゃ.
はつ is the main reading, but its sound often changes: 出発 しゅっぱつ, 発表 はっぴょう.
しゃ is the one you need: 医者. Do not mix up 者 with 暑 (hot), which has 日 on top.
Both readings are common: ち in 地図, じ in 地震. Learn them word by word.
ぎょう is all you need for N4: 授業, 卒業.
かた means person or way of doing (読み方), ほう means direction or side. In 夕方 it becomes がた.
Learn あたらしい and しん (新聞). 新しい keeps しい outside the kanji.
ば (場所, 場合) and じょう (会場, 工場) are both common. Places for a purpose often use じょう: 駐車場.
Only いん. Add it to a place to make a worker: 店員, 会社員. Do not mix up 員 (口 on top) with 買 (buy).
たつ (stand) is the N5 word. りつ often becomes りっ, as in 立派.
For N5 learn あく and あける. 開く can be read あく or ひらく, so check the context.
て is the main reading. Traps: 上手 is じょうず and 下手 is へた.
ちから is the word; りょく appears in compounds like 努力. Do not confuse 力 with katakana カ.
もん is what you need: 問題, 質問. Do not mix up 問 (口 inside) with 聞 (耳 inside) or 間 (日 inside).
だい is the main on reading: 時代. 代わる means to take someone's place; do not mix it up with 変わる (to change).
あかるい and めい (説明) matter most. 明日 is usually read あした, a special reading.
うごく and どう (動物, 運動) are both key. Do not confuse 動 with 働 (work), which adds 亻.
Only きょう matters: 東京, 京都.
め (eye) is the N5 word. As a suffix it shows order: 一番目, 二つ目.
Learn かよう (commute), とおる (pass) and つう (交通, 普通). Spell it とおり, not とうり.
いう and ことば are the ones for N5/N4. 言う sounds like ゆう but is written いう.
Only り: 料理, 理由. 理 is 王 plus 里 (village).
からだ (body) is the N5 word; たい appears in 大体. Do not mix up 体 (亻 + 本) with 休 (rest, 亻 + 木).
た is the one to know; in names it often becomes だ (山田). 田舎 has a special reading: いなか (countryside).
しゅ (主人) and おも (主に) are the useful ones. ご主人 means someone else's husband.
Only だい: 問題, 宿題.
Only い: 意味, 注意. 意 is 音 (sound) over 心 (heart).
Mostly ふ, meaning not: 不便 is not convenient. ぶ is rare (不器用).
つくる is the N5 word. さく (作文) and さ (作業) sound close, so learn them word by word.
よう is what you need: 用事, 用意. もちいる is formal writing.
ど is the key reading, for times and degrees: 一度, 今度. 支度 (getting ready) uses たく.
つよい and べんきょう are N5 words. 勉強 means study, even though 強 means strong.
こう is the reading to know: 公園.
もつ is the main reading: 持つ, 気持ち. じ only appears in harder words like 維持.
や is the one for N4: 野菜, 野球. の appears in 野原 and many names.
Only い, in 以上 (or more) and 以下 (or less). Both include the number itself.
おもう is the N4 word. 思い出 is おもいで, but 思い出す is おもいだす.
いえ, うち and か (家族) all matter. In 作家 and 画家, 家 means a person who does that job.
せ is the N4 reading: 世界, お世話. せい is for 世紀 (century).
おおい and たぶん are the ones to know. 多い is おおい, not おうい.
ただしい and しょう (お正月) matter at N4. せい appears in 正解 (correct answer).
やすい (cheap) and あん (安心) are both key. やすい means cheap, not easy (easy is 易しい やさしい).
Only いん: 病院. Do not confuse 病院 (hospital) with 美容院 (hair salon).
こころ and しん (心配, 安心) are the ones to learn.
Only かい, and 世界 is the word you need.
おしえる (teach) and きょう (教室) matter most. おそわる is the other side: to be taught.
ぶん is the main reading. 注文 (order) uses もん, a common trap.
げん in 元気 is the N5 word. 元日 (New Year's Day) uses がん.
おもい (heavy) is the N4 word. じゅう appears in 体重, ちょう in 貴重 (precious).
ちかい and きん (近所, 最近) are both N4 must knows.
かんがえる is the one to learn. Do not mix up 考 with 老 (old).
が (映画) and かく (計画) are both N4. Learn which word uses which reading.
うみ (sea) is the N5 word; かい appears in 海外 (overseas). 海 is water (氵) plus 毎.
うる (sell) is the key word. Its opposite is 買う (buy), which also has ばい as its on reading.
しる is the N5 word. Say 知っています for 'I know', and 知りません for 'I don't know'.
みち (road) is the N5 word; どう appears in 水道 and 柔道.
あつまる (things gather) and あつめる (you collect them) are both N4.
べつ (特別) and わかれる matter. Do not mix up 別れる (part from someone) with 分かれる (split into parts).
もの and ぶつ (動物) are both common. 荷物 (luggage) uses もつ, a classic trap.
つかう is the N5 word; し appears in 大使館 (embassy). Do not mix up 使 with 便 (as in 便利).
ひん (作品) and しな (品物) are the two readings. 品 is three 口 shapes stacked.
けい is the main reading: 時計 (clock), 計画.
しぬ is the N4 word. Both readings are し, so it is easy to read.
Only とく: 特に, 特別. In 特急 it becomes とっ.
わたし is the N5 word; わたくし is the polite form. 私立 (private school) uses し.
はじめる and はじまる are both N4. Do not mix up 始める with 初めて (for the first time).
あさ is the N5 reading. 今朝 has a special reading: けさ (this morning).
うん (運転, 運動) and はこぶ (carry) are both N4.
おわる is the N5 word. しゅう appears in 終電 (last train).
だい is also the counter for cars and machines: 一台. 台風 (typhoon) uses たい.
ひろい (wide) is the N4 word. こう appears in 広告 (advert).
すむ and じゅう (住所) are the N4 ones. Say 住んでいます for 'I live in'.
しん in 写真 is the N5 word. ま means right or pure: 真ん中 (the very middle).
ゆう in 有名 is the reading to know. ある is usually written in kana, not 有る.
くち is the N5 word. It becomes ぐち after another word: 入口, 出口.
すこし and すくない are both N5; watch the different okurigana. Do not mix up 少 with 小 (small).
まち (town) is the N5 word. In addresses, 〜町 is often read ちょう.
Only りょう: 料理, 料金. Do not mix up 料 (米 on the left) with 科 (禾 on the left).
こう is the main reading: 工場. 大工 (carpenter) and 工夫 use く.
{建|た}てる (to build) and {建物|たてもの} (building) are the N4 words. Do not mix it up with {健|けん} in {健康|けんこう}.

words.en: to become empty (e.g. a train, a stomach)

kanji.tip: Learn {空|そら} (sky), {空港|くうこう} (airport) and {空|あ}く (become empty). Same kanji, many readings: {空|す}く and {空|から} also mean empty.
Know {急|いそ}ぐ (to hurry) and {急|きゅう}に (suddenly). In {特急|とっきゅう} only the first kanji changes sound (とっ); this one stays きゅう.
{止|と}まる (it stops) and {止|と}める (you stop it) are the key pair. Trap: {泊|と}まる (stay the night) sounds the same.

words.en: to send; to see someone off

kanji.tip: {送|おく}る (to send) is the N4 word; {放送|ほうそう} (broadcast) uses そう. Do not confuse it with {迷|まよ}う, which looks similar.
{大切|たいせつ} and {親切|しんせつ} use せつ. In {切手|きって} and {切符|きっぷ}, き becomes きっ.
てん matters most: {自転車|じてんしゃ} and {運転|うんてん}. {転|ころ}ぶ means to fall over.
Learn it inside {研究|けんきゅう} (research). The kun word {研|と}ぐ is rare for you now.
{足|あし} (foot, leg) and {足|た}りる (be enough) are both N4. Counter for shoes: {一足|いっそく}, {三足|さんぞく} (そく becomes ぞく).
At N4 you only need {研究|けんきゅう}. Do not confuse it with {空|そら}: both have the same roof on top.
{楽|たの}しい (fun) and {音楽|おんがく} (music) are N5. {楽|らく} means easy, comfortable. In {楽器|がっき}, がく becomes がっ.
{起|お}きる (get up), {起|お}こす (wake someone), {起|お}こる (happen). Do not mix {起|お}こる with {怒|おこ}る (get angry).
{着|き}る (to wear) and {着|つ}く (to arrive) are both N4. Trap: {着|き}る and {切|き}る sound the same.
Alone it is {店|みせ}. In compound words it is てん: {喫茶店|きっさてん}, {店員|てんいん}.
びょう is the one to know: {病気|びょうき}, {病院|びょういん}. Trap: {病院|びょういん} (hospital) vs {美容院|びよういん} (hair salon).
Learn {質問|しつもん} (question). しち only appears in rare words like {質屋|しちや}.
{待|ま}つ (to wait) is N5. Do not confuse it with {持|も}つ (to hold): the left sides differ.
し matters most: {試験|しけん} (exam) and {試合|しあい} (match). {試|ため}す means to try out.
Learn {家族|かぞく} (family). Do not confuse it with {旅|たび}: they look alike.
Learn {銀行|ぎんこう} (bank). The left side is {金|かね} (money, metal).
{早|はや}い (early) is N5. Trap: {速|はや}い means fast (speed). {早速|さっそく} uses さっ.
Learn {映画|えいが} (movie). Trap: {映|うつ}す (show on a screen) and {写|うつ}す (copy, take a photo) sound the same.
{親切|しんせつ} (kind) and {両親|りょうしん} (parents) use しん; {親|おや} alone means parent. Left side looks like {新|しん}.
Learn {試験|しけん} (exam) and {経験|けいけん} (experience). Look alike kanji with the same sound: {危険|きけん}, {検査|けんさ}.
Learn {英語|えいご} (English). Almost always えい.
Learn {医者|いしゃ} (doctor). Note {歯医者|はいしゃ} (dentist).
Learn {仕事|しごと} (work) and {仕方|しかた}がない (it can't be helped).
Learn {去年|きょねん} (last year). In {過去|かこ} it reads こ.
Learn {意味|いみ} (meaning) and {味|あじ} (taste). Do not confuse it with {妹|いもうと} or {未来|みらい}: they look alike.
Learn {写真|しゃしん} (photo). Trap: {写|うつ}す (copy, take a photo) vs {映|うつ}す (show on a screen).
Almost always じ: {漢字|かんじ}, {文字|もじ}.
Learn {答|こた}える (to answer) and {答|こた}え (answer). とう appears in harder words.
{夜|よる} alone; {今夜|こんや} uses や; {夜中|よなか} uses よ.
{音|おと} (sound) and {音楽|おんがく} (music) are the key words. It also sits on top of {意|い} in {意味|いみ}.
Learn {注意|ちゅうい} (care, warning) and {注文|ちゅうもん} (order). The kun readings are rare at your level.
{帰|かえ}る (go home) is N5 and conjugates like a u verb: {帰|かえ}ります, {帰|かえ}って. Do not mix with {変|か}える (change).
Learn {古|ふる}い (old, for things). Do not use {古|ふる}い for old people.
Learn {歌|うた} (song) and {歌|うた}う (to sing). か appears in {歌手|かしゅ} (singer).
Learn {買|か}う (to buy). The bottom part means money; {貸|か}す (lend) has it too.
Learn {悪|わる}い (bad). あく appears in {最悪|さいあく} (the worst).
Trap: {図書館|としょかん} uses と, not ず. {地図|ちず} (map) uses ず.
Always しゅう: {毎週|まいしゅう}, {来週|らいしゅう}, {先週|せんしゅう}.
Always しつ at your level: {教室|きょうしつ} (classroom).
Learn {歩|ある}く (to walk). In {散歩|さんぽ} and {一歩|いっぽ}, ほ becomes ぽ.
{風|かぜ} alone is wind. Trap: {風邪|かぜ} (a cold) sounds the same. {風呂|ふろ} (bath) uses ふ.
{紙|かみ} alone is paper. In {手紙|てがみ} (letter) かみ becomes がみ.
Learn {黒|くろ}い (black). こく appears in {黒板|こくばん} (blackboard).
{花|はな} (flower) is the key word. Trap: {鼻|はな} (nose) sounds the same.
Learn {春|はる} (spring). しゅん is rare at your level.
Learn {赤|あか}い (red) and {赤|あか}ちゃん (baby).
Learn {青|あお}い (blue). It can also mean green: a green traffic light is {青信号|あおしんごう}.
Always かん, at the end of building words: {図書館|としょかん}, {映画館|えいがかん}.
や is the key reading: {部屋|へや} (room) and shop words like {本屋|ほんや}. {屋上|おくじょう} uses おく.
Learn {色|いろ} (colour). Trap: {景色|けしき} (scenery) uses しき.
Learn {走|はし}る (to run); it conjugates like a u verb: {走|はし}ります, {走|はし}って. You can see it inside {起|お}きる.

words.w: {春夏秋冬|しゅんかしゅうとう}

kanji.tip: Learn {秋|あき} (autumn). しゅう is rare at your level.
Learn {夏|なつ} (summer) and {夏休|なつやす}み. か and げ are rare at your level.
Learn {習|なら}う (to learn from someone) and {練習|れんしゅう} (practice).
Always えき: {駅|えき} alone is station.
よう often means Western: {洋服|ようふく} (clothes), {洋食|ようしょく} (Western food).
Learn {旅行|りょこう} (trip). Do not confuse it with {家族|かぞく}: the second kanji looks alike.
Always ふく: {服|ふく} alone means clothes.
Learn {夕方|ゆうがた} (evening). Special reading: {七夕|たなばた} (star festival).
Trap: {借|か}りる is borrow, {貸|か}す is lend. In {借金|しゃっきん}, しゃく becomes しゃっ.
Always よう, in the days of the week: {日曜日|にちようび}.
Learn {飲|の}む (to drink; also to take medicine). いん appears in harder words.
にく is an on reading but is used alone: {肉|にく} (meat).
Trap: {貸|か}す is lend, {借|か}りる is borrow. Both are か.
Always どう: {食堂|しょくどう} (canteen, dining hall).
Learn {鳥|とり} (bird). Do not confuse it with {島|しま} (island).
はん is the key reading: ご{飯|はん} (rice, meal). {飯|めし} is casual, mostly used by men.
Learn it inside {勉強|べんきょう} (study).
Learn {冬|ふゆ} (winter). とう is rare at your level.
Learn {昼|ひる} (noon, daytime) and {昼|ひる}ご{飯|はん} (lunch). Do not confuse it with {書|か}く: they look alike.
Mostly ちゃ: お{茶|ちゃ}, {茶色|ちゃいろ}. Trap: {喫茶店|きっさてん} uses さ.
Learn {弟|おとうと} (younger brother) and {兄弟|きょうだい} (brothers, siblings), where it reads だい.
Learn {牛|うし} (cow) and {牛乳|ぎゅうにゅう} (milk).
Learn {魚|さかな} (fish). ぎょ appears in {金魚|きんぎょ} (goldfish).
{兄|あに} is your own older brother; お{兄|にい}さん is polite or someone else's. {兄弟|きょうだい} uses きょう.
Learn {犬|いぬ} (dog). Do not confuse it with {大|おお}きい or {太|ふと}い: only the dot differs.
Learn {妹|いもうと} (younger sister). Do not confuse it with {味|あじ}: they look alike.
{姉|あね} is your own older sister; お{姉|ねえ}さん is polite or someone else's.
Learn it inside {漢字|かんじ}.
にち and ひ matter most. Dates use か ({三日|みっか}). Learn {今日|きょう}, {明日|あした}, {一日|ついたち} as whole words.
Learn いち and ひと(つ). Trap: {一日|いちにち} (one day) and {一日|ついたち} (the 1st of the month) are written the same.
くに alone and こく in compounds. In {中国|ちゅうごく} the sound changes to ごく.
Nationality is じん, counting people is にん, but 1 and 2 people are ひとり, ふたり. {大人|おとな} (adult) is a special reading. Do not mix up {人|ひと} and {入|はい}る (enter).
ねん is the one you will use most. Trap: {今年|ことし} (this year) is a special reading.
Know おお(きい), だい and たい: learn which word uses which. {大人|おとな} (adult) is special. Do not mix up {大|おお}きい, {犬|いぬ} (dog) and {太|ふと}い (fat).

words.w: {十人十色|じゅうにんといろ}

kanji.tip: じゅう is the main reading. Trap: {十分|じゅうぶん} (enough) and {十分|じゅっぷん} (ten minutes) are written the same. {二十歳|はたち} (20 years old) is special.
に and ふた(つ) are what you need. Watch the dates: {二日|ふつか}, {二十日|はつか} (the 20th).
ほん is the reading. As a counter for long things it changes: いっぽん, にほん, さんぼん, ろっぽん.
なか and ちゅう are key. After a word, ちゅう means during ({授業中|じゅぎょうちゅう}) and じゅう means all through ({一日中|いちにちじゅう}).
なが(い) is N5. ちょう in a word usually means the boss or head of something.
Learn {出|で}る (you go out) and {出|だ}す (you take something out). しゅつ often becomes しゅっ, as in {出発|しゅっぱつ}.
さん and みっ(つ). After さん the next sound often changes: {三本|さんぼん}, {三階|さんがい}.
じ for clock times, とき for when. Trap: {時計|とけい} (clock) is a special reading.
{行|い}く and こう are the big ones. The te-form is irregular: {行|い}って, not いいて.
み is the main reading. Keep {見|み}る (look), {見|み}える (be visible) and {見|み}せる (show) apart. Do not mix up {見|み}る and {貝|かい} (shell).
Month names use がつ, but counting months and Monday use げつ. Trap: one month is {一|いっ}か{月|げつ}.
Learn {後|あと} (after, time) and {後|うし}ろ (behind, place), plus {午後|ごご}.
まえ is the main reading. It is the opposite of {後|あと}: {午前|ごぜん} a.m., {午後|ごご} p.m.

words.w: {一生懸命|いっしょうけんめい}

kanji.tip: This kanji has many readings: せい first, then う(まれる) and い(きる). Trap: in {誕生日|たんじょうび} it is じょう, not せい.
ご and いつ(つ). Do not mix up {五日|いつか} (the 5th) and the word いつか (someday).
かん and あいだ are key. In {人間|にんげん} it changes to げん. Do not mix up {間|あいだ} with {聞|き}く (hear) or {問題|もんだい} (problem).
うえ and じょう matter most. {上手|じょうず} (good at) is the opposite of {下手|へた}.
ひがし alone, とう in {東京|とうきょう}. Station exits are useful: {東口|ひがしぐち}.
Mostly よん. Traps: {四時|よじ} (not よんじ), {四人|よにん}, and {四月|しがつ}.
いま and こん. Special readings to learn as whole words: {今日|きょう}, {今年|ことし}, {今朝|けさ}.
お{金|かね} (money) and {金曜日|きんようび} are the N5 words. {金|きん} alone means gold.
Mostly きゅう. Traps: {九月|くがつ} and {九時|くじ}, never きゅうじ.
{入|はい}る (you go in) and {入|い}れる (you put something in) are both N5. Do not mix up {入|はい}る and {人|ひと} (person).
がく is the reading you need. Before k sounds it becomes がっ, as in {学校|がっこう}.
{高|たか}い means both tall and expensive. Its opposites differ: {低|ひく}い (low) and {安|やす}い (cheap).
えん (yen) is what you need. Round is usually written {丸|まる}い, not {円|まる}い.
こ is the main reading. し and す appear at the end of words like {帽子|ぼうし} and {椅子|いす}. Do not mix up {子|こ} and {字|じ} (letter).
そと and がい are the ones for N5 and N4.
はち and やっ(つ). Trap: {八日|ようか} (the 8th) sounds like {四日|よっか} (the 4th).
ろく and むっ(つ). It often becomes ろっ before k, p, h sounds: {六本|ろっぽん}.
した and くだ(さい) are N5. Trap: {下手|へた} (bad at) is a special reading.
{来|く}る changes when it conjugates: {来|き}ます, {来|こ}ない. らい in a word means next.
き is almost always the reading. Learn phrases: {気|き}をつける (be careful), {気|き}がつく (notice).
ちい(さい) and しょう. Do not mix up {小|ちい}さい (small) and {少|すく}ない (few).
なな is safer when you speak, because しち sounds like いち. Use しち in {七月|しちがつ}.
やま alone. After a mountain's name it is さん, like {富士山|ふじさん}, which is not the さん for people.
{話|はな}す is the verb, {話|はなし} (no す) is the noun. わ is in {電話|でんわ}. Do not mix up {話|はなし} and {語|ご} (language).
おんな and じょ. {女性|じょせい} is the polite word; おんな alone can sound rude about a person.
きた is the main reading. In {北海道|ほっかいどう} it becomes ほっ.
Only ご matters, in {午前|ごぜん} and {午後|ごご}. Do not mix up {午|ご} (noon) and {牛|うし} (cow), which has a line sticking up.
ひゃく, but watch the sound changes: さんびゃく, ろっぴゃく, はっぴゃく. Do not mix up {百|ひゃく} and {白|しろ} (white).
か(く) and しょ are both N5. Do not mix up {書|か}く (write) and {昼|ひる} (noon).

words.en: before you, excuse me for leaving first

kanji.tip: せん is the big one. With time words it means last: {先週|せんしゅう} (last week), while {来週|らいしゅう} is next week.
な in {名前|なまえ} and めい in {有名|ゆうめい} are what you need for N5.
Just かわ. In names it often becomes がわ, like {品川|しながわ}. Do not mix up {川|かわ} and {三|さん} (three).
せん, but {三千|さんぜん} and {八千|はっせん} change sound. Do not mix up {千|せん} and {干|ほ}す (dry).
みず alone and すい in {水曜日|すいようび}. Do not mix up {水|みず} (water) and {氷|こおり} (ice).
Only はん matters for N5 and N4.
おとこ and だん. The kanji is a field ({田|た}) plus power ({力|ちから}).
にし alone. Do not mix up {西|にし} (west) and {四|よん} (four), they look alike.
Always でん. The kanji has rain ({雨|あめ}) on top, from lightning.
Always こう for you. Do not mix up {学校|がっこう} and {交番|こうばん} (police box): the left part is a tree.
ご is the one you need: add it to a country name for its language, like {英語|えいご}. Do not mix up {語|ご} and {話|はなし} (talk).
ど in {土曜日|どようび} is N5. Trap: お{土産|みやげ} (souvenir) is a special reading.
き alone and もく in {木曜日|もくようび}. Do not mix up {木|き} (tree) and {本|ほん} (book), which has an extra line.
{聞|き}く means hear and also ask. Do not mix up {聞|き}く (an ear in a gate) and {間|あいだ} (between).
{食|た}べる and しょく are both needed. {食|く}う is rough, casual speech.
くるま alone and しゃ in compounds. Do not mix up {車|くるま} and {東|ひがし} (east).
Use なん before counters and before d, t, n sounds ({何|なん}ですか), and なに elsewhere ({何|なに}を).
みなみ is the one for N5 and N4.
まん. Japanese counts big numbers in units of 10,000, so 100,000 is {十万|じゅうまん}.
Always まい, put before a time word to mean every. Do not mix up {毎日|まいにち} and {母|はは} (mother).
しろ is the reading you need, including in {面白|おもしろ}い. Do not mix up {白|しろ} and {百|ひゃく} (hundred).
てん is what you need, mostly in {天気|てんき}. Do not mix up {天|てん} (sky) and {夫|おっと} (husband).
Say {母|はは} for your own mother and お{母|かあ}さん (special reading) for someone else's.
ひ alone and か in {火曜日|かようび}.
みぎ is what you need. Do not mix up {右|みぎ} (right, with {口|くち}) and {左|ひだり} (left, with a shape like エ).
{読|よ}む is N5. Do not mix up {読|よ}む (read) and {売|う}る (sell), which is its right side.
とも in {友達|ともだち} is the N5 word. Do not mix up {友|とも} (friend) and {反対|はんたい} (against).
ひだり is what you need. Do not mix up {左|ひだり} (left, with a shape like エ) and {右|みぎ} (right, with {口|くち}).
やす(む) is N5. The kanji is a person resting by a tree ({木|き}). Do not mix up {休|やす}む and {体|からだ} (body).
Say {父|ちち} for your own father and お{父|とう}さん (special reading) for someone else's.
For N5 and N4 you mostly need あめ. う shows up in news words like {雷雨|らいう}.

words.hook: Woman (女) + of (の) + person (人): a woman.
日 is sun or day; it is read か when counting days, like 三日 (みっか, three days).
日 (day) is read じつ in formal words like 平日 (weekday) and 休日 (day off).
一 (one) is read ひと before words: 一つ (one thing), 一言 (ひとこと, one word).
Brush or writing (筆) + person (者): the person holding the pen, the writer.
行 can mean a line or row: 一行 (いちぎょう) is one line of text.
Pull (引) your things across (越) to a new home: moving house.
Resources (資) + materials (料): the papers and data you need.
限 means limit: かぎり is the limit, as far as it goes.
手 (hand) can mean a skilled person: 選手 (せんしゅ) is a chosen hand, a player.
家 (house) is read け after family names: 田中家 is the Tanaka family.
前 (before) is read ぜん: 食前 (しょくぜん) means before meals.
前 (before) at the front: 前首相 is the former prime minister.
間 is the sun (日) seen through a gate (門): the gap between, like 一週間 (a week's span).
願 means wish or request: polite お + wish + します, I humbly ask, please.
今 (now) is read こん: 今月 (this month), 今週 (this week).
Master or main (主) + person (人): the main person of the house, your husband.
発 means start or set off: 東京発 means departing from Tokyo.
Water (水) + day of the week (曜): water day, Wednesday.
上 (up, above) is read うわ in words like 上着 (うわぎ, outer jacket).
Warm (温) + spring (泉): a warm spring, a hot spring.
部 means section or part: 一部 (いちぶ) is one part.
Trade (商) + shop (店): a shop where trade happens.
Flower (花) + fire (火): fire flowers in the sky, fireworks.
車 (car, vehicle) is read しゃ: 電車 (electric car, train), 自動車 (car).
社 means company: 三社 (さんしゃ) is three companies, like 会社.
Named after Ding, a legendary Chinese cook: "whoa, chop!" (ほうちょう) with the kitchen knife.
毎 means every: after a word it is read ごと, like 一時間毎 (いちじかんごと, every hour).
毎 (every) is read まい: 毎日 (every day), 毎朝 (every morning).
小 (small) is read こ: 小鳥 (ことり, little bird), 小雨 (こさめ, light rain).
夜 (night) is read や when counting nights: 一夜 (いちや, one night).
最 means most: 最高 (most high, the best), 最初 (the very first).
長 (long) also means chief or head: 社長 (company head), 校長 (principal).
長 (long) is read ちょう: 長時間 (long hours), 長距離 (long distance).
長い (ながい) means long: 長袖 (ながそで, long sleeves), 長生き (long life).
Construction (工) + work or matter (事): building work, construction.
女 (woman) is read じょ: 長女 (eldest daughter), 次女 (second daughter).
女 (woman) is read じょ at the front: 女子 (girl), 女性 (woman).
Hang (懸) your life (命) on it: giving everything, as in 一生懸命.
小学 (small learning, elementary school) + 生 (student): an elementary school pupil.
足 means foot but also enough: 足りる and the older 足る both mean to be enough.
料 means fee: 入場料 (entry fee), 送料 (shipping fee).
者 means person: 学者 (scholar), 医者 (doctor).
Fishing (漁) + master or expert (師): a fishing pro, a fisherman.
山 (mountain) is read さん after names: 富士山 (Mount Fuji).
Gold (金) + fish (魚): the little gold fish, a goldfish.
Original (原) + draft (稿): the original draft, a manuscript.
Flat or ordinary (平) + day (日): an ordinary day, a weekday.
State (申) + request (請): formally state your request, an application.
Picture (図) + mirror or model (鑑): a book of pictures to look things up, a field guide.
Full (満) + members (員): every person's spot is filled, a full house.
寸 (an old inch unit) + method (法): the way of measuring, size.
Compile or knit (編) + collect (集): collect pieces and knit them together, editing.
紙 (paper) is read し: 新聞紙 (newspaper), 和紙 (Japanese paper).
Respect (敬) + language (語): respectful language, honorifics.
New (新) + trunk or main (幹) + line (線): the new main line, the bullet train.
Playful art (俳) + phrase (句): a short playful poem of 5, 7, 5 sounds.
Bath (浴) + clothes (衣): what you wear after the bath, a summer kimono.
高 (high) is read こう: 高校 (high school), 高速 (high speed).
下 (under) is read か: 以下 (いか, below), 地下 (ちか, underground).
教 (teach) is read きょう: a teaching becomes a religion, like 仏教 (Buddhism).
道 (road) also means a way of life: 柔道 (the gentle way, judo), 書道 (calligraphy).
初 (first) is read しょ: 初日 (しょにち, first day), 初級 (beginner level).
所 (place) is read しょ: 住所 (address), 事務所 (じむしょ, office).
所 (place) is read じょ in some words: 近所 (きんじょ, neighbourhood).
名 (name) is read めい to count people: 三名 (three people) is the polite way.
名 (name) is read めい for famous things: 名所 (famous place), 名作 (masterpiece).
元気 (origin + energy, healthy): stay full of energy, take care.
From 待つ (wait) + ください (please): please wait, said politely.
Younger brother (弟) + child (子): like a little brother to the master, a pupil.
Lamp (灯) + stand (台): a lamp on a tall stand, a lighthouse.
場 (place) is read じょう: 会場 (meeting place, venue), 工場 (factory).
歩 (walk) is read ほ to count steps: 一歩 (いっぽ, one step), 二歩 (にほ).
問 (question) is read もん to count questions: 第一問 (question one).
From (以) + go down (降): from that point on down the line, hereafter.
Extend (延) + long (長): make it longer, an extension (like overtime).
From 休む (rest): お休み is a rest, a day off, or good night.
Go out (出) + stretch (張): stretching out to work far away, a business trip.
Old or former (故) + home village (郷): your old home village, your hometown.
外 (outside) is read がい: 予想外 (beyond expectations), 時間外 (out of hours).
外 (outside) is read がい at the front: 外国 (foreign country), 外食 (eating out).
画 (picture) is read が: 映画 (えいが, movie), 日本画 (Japanese painting).
着 means wear and also arrive: 一着 (one suit, or first to arrive).
校 (school) is read こう: 学校, 高校; 三校 means three schools.
Win (勝) + hand (手): your hand always wins, so you do things your own way.
Against (対) + plan (策): a plan against a problem, a countermeasure.
Hand (手) + front (前): right in front of your hand, this side.
Electricity (電) + pond (池): a little pond of electricity, a battery.
That very (当) + day (日): on the day itself.
Enter (入) + company (社): joining a company.
通 (pass through) is read つう: letters pass through the post, 一通 (one letter).
同 (same) is read どう: 同時 (same time), 同級生 (classmate).
業 (business, work) is read ぎょう: 工業 (industry), 農業 (farming).
足 (foot) is read そく to count pairs of shoes: 一足 (いっそく, one pair).
風 (wind) also means style: 和風 (Japanese style), 洋風 (Western style).
Sell (売) + raise (上): the money raised by selling, sales.
Wear (着) + change (替): change what you wear, a change of clothes.
Polish (研) + study (修): polishing your skills, job training.
Figure (姿) + force (勢): how your body holds itself, posture or attitude.
Send out (発) + sell (売): sending it out for sale, a release.
Day (日) + day (日): which day it is, a date.
Military (武) + warrior (士): a samurai.
空 (sky, empty) is read くう: 空港 (airport), 空席 (empty seat).
古い (ふるい) means old: 古本 (ふるほん, used book), 古着 (used clothes).
館 (large building) is read かん: 図書館 (library), 美術館 (art museum).
国 (country) is read こく: 外国 (foreign country), 中国 (China).
病 (illness) is read びょう: 病気 (illness), 心臓病 (heart disease).
From 帰る (return home): お帰り is welcome back.
釜 is father (父) on top of metal (金): father's big metal pot.
Can (缶) + packed (詰): food packed in a can.
Carry out (行) + matter (事): things carried out each year, events.
配 means hand out: くばる is giving things to everyone.
Calculate (算) + number (数): calculating numbers, arithmetic.
Vehicle (車) + manage (掌): the person who manages the train car, the conductor.
Ride (乗) + vehicle (車): getting on a train or car.
Hand (手) + notebook (帳): a notebook that fits in your hand.
Electric (電) + wave (波): electric waves, radio signals.
Talk (話) + together (合): talking together, a discussion.
Beauty (美) + appearance (容): beauty care, like a beauty salon (美容院).
Main (本) + section (部): the main section, headquarters.
Food (食 side) + join (并): rice pounded and joined into one sticky cake.
歌 (song) is read か: 国歌 (national anthem), 校歌 (school song).
