機 (machine) is read き: 飛行機 (airplane), 洗濯機 (washing machine).
口 (mouth) means an opening: 入り口 (entrance), 出口 (でぐち, exit).
室 (room) is read しつ: 教室 (classroom), 和室 (Japanese style room).
室 (room) is read しつ at the front: 室内 (indoors), 室温 (room temperature).
怪 means strange or mysterious: あやしい is something strange, suspicious.
先 means ahead: お先に is I will go ahead first, or please go first.
世話 means care: you took care of me, thank you.
Inspect (改) + ticket (札): where tickets are checked, the ticket gate.
Month (月) + end (末): the end of the month.
Words (言葉) + use (遣い): how you use your words.
Tie shut (締) + cut (切): shut and cut off, the deadline.
Celebrate (祝) + day (日): a day of celebration, a national holiday.
Job or skill (職) + person (人): a person with a skilled trade, a craftsman.
Job (職) + place (場): the place of your job, the workplace.
University (大学) + institution (院): the school after university, graduate school.
Pass on (通) + know (知): passing it on so others know, a notice.
申し訳 (an excuse I offer) + ない (none): I have no excuse, I am sorry.
感 (feeling) is read かん: 安心感 (sense of safety), 責任感 (sense of duty).
頭 (head) is read とう to count big animals by the head: 牛三頭 (three cows).
集 (collect) is read しゅう: 写真集 (photo collection), 作品集 (collected works).
力 (power) is read りょく: 体力 (body strength), 学力 (school ability).
One or first (一) + stream or class (流): first class, top level.
Sell (売) + cut off (切): selling until the stock is cut off, sold out.
Guest (客) + seat (席): seats for the guests, the audience seats.
Rest (休) + business (業): the business is resting, closed.
Think about (稽) + the old (古): studying the old ways, practice.
School (校) + garden or yard (庭): the school yard.
Make (作) + person (者): the person who made it, the author.
People (人) + matters (事): matters about people, human resources.
Examine (診) + judge (断): examine, then judge, a diagnosis.
Metal (金) + order (令): a metal thing that rings out, a bell.
Each other (相) + strike (撲): striking each other, sumo wrestling.
Storehouse (倉) + storage (庫): a building for storing things, a warehouse.
What (何) + part (分): whatever the case, so please, by all means.
From 果たす (carry out; 果 is fruit or result): when the result comes, sure enough.
日 (day) + にち (day again): which day, the date.
Sun (日) + の + come out (出): the sun comes out, sunrise.
響 means echo: ひびき is a sound echoing around.
Mark (標) + origin (本): a marked example kept as a model, a specimen.
Origin (本) + come (来): what comes from the origin, by nature.
True (真) + blue (青): truly blue, or pale as a ghost.
True (真) + white (白): truly white, pure white.
Look (見) + fix (直): look again to fix it, review.
No (無) + number (数): too many to number, countless.
Things (物) + put (置): a place to put things, a storeroom.
園 (garden) is read えん: 公園 (park), 動物園 (zoo).
発 (fire, shoot) is read はつ to count shots: 一発 (いっぱつ, one shot).
重 (heavy) is read じゅう: 重工業 (heavy industry), 重要 (important).
色 (colour) is read しょく: 三色 (さんしょく, three colours).
反 (against) is read はん: 反対 (opposite), 反戦 (anti war).
勝 (win) is read しょう to count wins: 三勝 (three wins).
From 付く (attach): 付き means comes with, like 朝食付き (breakfast included).
内 (inside) is read ない: 国内 (in the country), 社内 (in the company).
竹 looks like two bamboo stalks with leaves hanging down: bamboo.
点 (dot, point) is read てん: 百点 (a hundred points, full marks).
期 (period of time) is read き: 学期 (school term), 時期 (time, season).
Foot (足) + base (元): the ground at your feet.
改 means renew: 改めて is doing it again, anew.
From 追う (chase): 追いかける is running after someone.
Study (学) + section (部): a study section of a university, a faculty.
God (神) + honoured (様): the honoured god.
Dry (乾) + cup (杯): drink until the cup is dry, cheers!
Wear (着) + replace (替): replace what you wear, change clothes.
Ceremony (儀) + form (式): a formal ceremony, a ritual.
Craft (工) + man (夫): the craftsman's clever ideas, ingenuity.
Shape (形) + style (式): the shape something takes, a format.
Public (公) + together (共): shared together by the public.
Exchange (交) + replace (代): take turns, swap.
Four (四) + corners (角): four cornered, square.
Real (実) + feeling (感): a real feeling, truly sensing it.
Go out (出) + work duty (勤): going out to work.
Block (障) + 子 (noun ending): a paper screen that blocks the view, a sliding door.
Upper (上) + quality (品): high quality, refined.
Deep (深) + night (夜): deep in the night.
From 少ない (few): even counting few, at least.
Sex or nature (性) + separate (別): separating by sex, gender.
Tea (茶) + colour (色): tea coloured, brown.
Months (月) + days (日): the months and days that pass, time.
Stop (停) + car (車): when a train or car stops, for example at a station.
Points (点) + number (数): the number of points you get, your score.
Ask (問い) + match up (合わせ): you ask questions to match up the facts, an inquiry.
Climb (登) onto the place (場), the stage: an actor makes an entry.
懐 is your bosom or heart: old memories held close to your heart feel dear and missed.
Day (日) + extent or process (程): how your days are planned out, a schedule.
Send out (発) + thought (想): the way new ideas come out of your head.
Skin (皮) and flesh (肉), but no bone: words nice on the surface that still bite, sarcasm.
Daytime (昼) + sleep (寝): a sleep in the middle of the day, a nap.
Truly (真) dark (暗): so dark you see nothing at all, total darkness.
自 means self (as in 自分): doing something yourself, personally.
Water (水) + wear (着): clothes you wear in the water, a swimsuit.
Famous name (名) + thing (物): the thing a place is famous for.
Role or duty (役) + place (所): the place where public duties are done, a government office.
Role or duty (役) + person (人): a person with a public role, a government official.
Night (夜) + go (行): going through the night, like a night train.
Cold (冷) + freeze (凍): making food so cold that it freezes.
Divide (割) + pull (引): pull a part off the price, a discount.
第 goes before numbers to show order: 第一 is the 1st, 第二 is the 2nd.
弁 means speech: 関西弁 is the way people speak in Kansai, the Kansai dialect.
現 means now or appear: 現社長 is the president right now, the present one.
商 means trade (as in 商売): 宝石商 is a jewel merchant.
化 means change: 自動化 is changing to automatic, like English "-ize".
席 means seat: 三席 is three seats, and 座席 is a seat in a car or theater.
短 means short: 短期間 is a short period of time.
寺 means temple: after a name it reads じ, like 金閣寺, the Golden Pavilion temple.
Foot (足) + trace or mark (跡): the mark your foot leaves, a footprint.
味 means taste: to taste something slowly and enjoy it.
Say (言い) + put out (出す): to bring out an idea by saying it first.
Raise (育) + child (児): raising children, childcare.
One (一) + equal or even (斉): everyone moves together as one, all at once.
One (一) + fixed (定): kept at one fixed level, regular and settled.
Banquet (宴) + meeting (会): a meeting with food and drink, a party.
Kindness (恩) + blessing (恵): good things you get from others, a benefit.
Each (各) + self (自): each person by themselves, individually.
Each (各) + land or place (地): each place, various parts of the country.
One side (片) + road (道): going only one way, a one way trip.
担 means carry or bear (as in 担当, being in charge): to carry something on your shoulder.
Temporary (仮) + name (名): kana were the simple stand-in letters, next to "real" kanji.
Barrier (関) + east (東): the land east of the old barrier gates, the Tokyo area.
Look at (看) + board (板): a board people look at, a signboard.
Base (基) + board or plate (盤): a solid base board everything sits on, a foundation.
Fear (恐) + shrink (縮): you shrink with fear for troubling someone, "I'm so sorry".
High (高) + grade or rank (級): high grade, first rate.
交 means cross or mix: 交差 is lines crossing, and 交差点 is where roads cross.
Lecture (講) + teacher (師): a teacher who gives lectures, a lecturer.
Crimson (紅) + leaf (葉): leaves turning red in autumn.
Small (小) + spend (遣い): small money to spend, pocket money.
錆 has metal (金) on the left: the stuff that grows on metal, rust.
Self (自) + home (宅): your own home.
Real (実) + achievement (績, as in 成績, grades): results you have really achieved.
Tie shut (締) + cut (切): the door is shut and cut off, the deadline.
End (終) + point (点): the end point of a train line, the last stop.
End (終) + finish (了): completely finished, the end.
Receive or take (受) + test (験, as in 試験): taking an exam.
Water (水) + face or surface (面): the face of the water, its surface.
Gap (隙) + space between (間): a small space between things, a crack.
住 means live (as in 住む): the place where you live, your home.
Clean (清) + sweep (掃): sweeping to make a place clean.
接 means touch or connect: to come into contact with people and deal with them.
Line (線) + road (路): the road of lines a train runs on, the track.
Create (創) + make (作): making something new, a creation.
Thick or big (太) + drum (鼓): a big drum.
Rice field (田) + plant (植え): planting rice in the field.
絶える means to die out or stop; 絶えず is "without stopping", constantly.
Know (知) + person (人): a person you know, an acquaintance.
Tune (調) + put in order (整): tuning things until they are right, adjustment.
Directly (直) + before (前): just before something happens.
Hand (手) + wash (洗い): the place where you wash your hands, the restroom.
Fixed (定) + price (価): the fixed, set price.
Electric (電) + ball (球): a glass ball that glows with electricity, a light bulb.
Raw (生) + mind (意) + spirit (気): a raw, unripe spirit acting too big, cheeky.
Raw (生) mind (意) and spirit (気): cheeky; with な it describes a noun, like 生意気な子.
Day or date (日) + time (時): the date and time.
Day (日) + lesson or task (課): the task you do every day, your routine.
Year (年) + degree or time (度): the year used by schools and businesses, the fiscal year.
上 means up: going up a hill, or the "up" train toward Tokyo.
Ride (乗り) + change (換え): change from one train or bus to another.
初 means first (as in 初めて): first of all, to begin with.
Sun (日) + hit (当たり): how much the sun hits a place, a sunny spot.
Sun (日) + shine in (差し, as in 日が差す): the sunlight shining in.
響 has sound (音) at the bottom: a sound that echoes and resounds.
Front or surface (表) + paper (紙): the front paper of a book, the cover.
Mail (便, as in 郵便) + note paper (箋): paper for writing letters.
Divide (分) + kind (類): dividing things into kinds, classification.
箒 has bamboo (竹) on top: bamboo tied together to sweep, a broom.
Herd cattle (牧) + place (場): a place where animals are kept and graze, a farm.
Call for (募) + gather (集): calling for people and gathering them, recruitment.
盆 has a dish (皿) at the bottom: a tray; お盆 is also the summer festival for the dead.
See (見) + put out (出し): words put out to be seen first, a heading.
Red (紅) leaves (葉): the tree whose leaves go red in autumn, the maple.
Role (役) + 目 (a point or item): the part you must do, your duty.
Medicine (薬) + bureau or office (局): the office that gives out medicine, a pharmacy.
Extra (余) + count (計): counting more than you need, too much.
Reason or logic (理) + subject (科): the school subject about how nature works, science.
形 means shape (as in 形 かたち): 三角形 is a triangle shape.
港 means port (みなと): 横浜港 is Yokohama port.
島 means island (しま): 日本列島 is the chain of Japanese islands.
流 means flow: 日本流 is the Japanese way, how things flow in Japan.
酒 means alcohol (さけ): 日本酒 is Japanese sake, 果実酒 is fruit alcohol.
汁 has water (氵) on the left: the liquid part, juice or soup like 味噌汁.
号 means number or name: 3号 is issue No. 3 of a magazine, or a ship name like タイタニック号.
船 means ship (ふね): 貨物船 is a cargo ship.
戦 means battle or fight: 決勝戦 is the final match.
和 means peace and also Japan: 和室 is a Japanese style room, 和食 is Japanese food.
済 means finished (as in 済む): 確認済 means already checked.
費 has shell money (貝) at the bottom, it means cost: 交通費 is travel cost.
両 means both: 両手 is both hands, 両親 is both parents.
器 means tool or container: 食器 is eating dishes, 楽器 is a music instrument.
Year (年) + student (生, as in 学生): 一年生 is a first year student.
科 means section or subject: 理科 is science, 外科 is the surgery department.
産 means give birth or produce: 日本産 is produced in Japan, made in Japan.
綱 has thread (糸) on the left: many threads twisted into a thick rope.
粒 has rice (米) on the left: small grains, like grains of rice.
Forest (林) over deer (鹿): deer live in the woods at the foot of the mountain.
Feeling (気) + taste (味): a slight taste of something, like 風邪気味 (a bit of a cold).
振り means swing: 三年振り is the first time in three years, after a gap.
論 has words (言) on the left: words that argue an idea, a theory, like 進化論.
団 means group (as in 集団): 応援団 is a cheering squad.
Blue (青) + white (白い): a face so pale it looks bluish white.
Become light (明け) + time or way (方): the time when the sky gets light, dawn.
Easy (安) + easy (易): doing things too easily without thinking hard.
Clothes (衣) + food (食) + home (住): the three things everyone needs to live.
One (一) + past (昨) + day (日): one more day past yesterday (昨日), the day before yesterday.
"Go (行って) and come back": what you say to someone leaving home, see you later.
井 looks like the wooden frame over a well; add door (戸): a water well.
Back (裏) + mouth or opening (口): the opening at the back, the back door.
Sell (売) + raise (上): the money raised by selling, sales.
Picture (絵) + tool (具): the tools for painting pictures, paints.
Smoke (煙) + stick out (突): the part that sticks out of the roof for smoke, a chimney.
Go (往) + return (復): go and come back, a round trip.
Eldest brother (伯) + father (父): your parent's older brother, uncle.
Younger brother (叔) + father (父): your parent's younger brother, uncle.
惜 has heart (忄) on the left: your heart feels it is a pity, so close, regrettable.
叔父 is uncle; with さん it is "uncle", also used for any middle aged man.
Big (大) + thing (事): treat your health as a big, important thing; get well soon.
Eldest (伯) + mother (母): your parent's older sister, aunt.
Younger (叔) + mother (母): your parent's younger sister, aunt.
参 means to humbly go (as in 参る): going to visit a shrine or temple.
待 means wait: "I made you wait", so sorry to keep you waiting.
Thought (思い) + cut (切り): cut off your doubts and go with all your strength.
Open (開) + meeting (会): the opening of a meeting.
Untie (解) + scatter (散): the group unties and scatters, a breakup.
Times or turns (回) + number (数): the number of times.
Change (改) + correct (正): changing a rule to make it right, an amendment.
Corner or angle (角) + degree (度): how many degrees an angle is.
Study (学) + grade (級): a group of students in the same grade, a class.
兼 is a hand holding two stalks of grain: doing two jobs at once.
空 means sky or empty (空 から alone is "empty"): nothing inside at all.
Feeling (感) + intense (激): a very strong feeling, deeply moved.
Look closely (鑑) + praise (賞): looking closely at art to enjoy it.
View (観) + thought (念): how you see something in your mind, an idea.
Base (基) + foundation stone (礎): the stones under a building, the basics.
Strong (強) + change into (化): to make something stronger.
Go (行) + row or line (列): people going in a line, a queue or parade.
Section (区) + cut (切る): cut something into sections, to mark off.
Bitter or painful (苦) + feelings (情): bitter feelings you tell someone, a complaint.
Art or skill (芸) + ability (能): skills shown to the public, entertainment.
Shape (形) + appearance (容) + word (詞): a word that tells how something looks, an adjective.
Outside (外) + section (科): the department that treats the body by cutting, surgery.
削 has a knife (刂) on the right: shave or cut away little by little.
Make clear (顕) + tiny (微) + lens (鏡): a lens that makes tiny things clear.
Public (公) + harm (害): harm done to the public, pollution.
Official (公) + style or ceremony (式): the official way; also a math formula.
Traffic (交通) + system or engine (機関): the systems that carry people, like trains and buses.
Public (公) + duty (務): work for the public, official business.
Match (合) + logic (理): it matches logic, rational.
Mix (交) + flow (流): people or ideas flow and mix, an exchange.
擦 has a hand (扌) on the left: rub something with your hand.
Honorable (御) + excuse (免): please excuse me, pardon or sorry.
Small (小) + finger (指): the small finger.
Make (作) + complete (成): make something until it is done, like a document.
探 has a hand (扌) on the left: feel around with your hand to search.
Sit (座) + futon (布団): a little futon you sit on, a floor cushion.
Three (三) + corner (角): three corners, a triangle.
Low (下) + town (町): the low part of town where common people lived, old downtown.
Self (自) + govern (治): governing yourselves, autonomy.
Damp (湿) + air (気): damp air, humidity.
Real (実) + thing (物): the real thing, not a picture or copy.
Sounds like "share": a joke or pun you share with friends. Same kanji as お洒落 (stylish).
Gather (集) + come together (合): everyone gathers in one place, an assembly.
Receive (受) + talk (話) + device (器): the device that receives talk, a phone receiver.
Steam (蒸) + air or gas (気): water as hot gas, steam.
Up (上) + down (下): up and down, high and low.
Trade (商) + company (社): a trading company.
Upper or first (上) + ten days (旬): the first ten days of a month.
Win (勝) + lose (負): a contest to see who wins and who loses.
Straight (正) + face (面): the side straight in front of you, the front.
Eat (食) + container (器): containers you eat from, dishes.
Writing (書) + way (道): the way of writing, calligraphy.
Know (知り) + each other (合い): people who know each other, an acquaintance.
Plain (素) + person (人): a plain person with no training, an amateur. Think しろ, a blank white page.
Water (水) + flat (平): flat like the top of still water, horizontal.
Water (水) + flat (平) + line (線): the flat line where sea meets sky, the horizon.
Like (好き) + dislike (嫌い): your likes and dislikes, often about food.
Plain (素) + straight (直): plain and straight, honest and obedient.
Nature (性) + ability (能): what a machine can do by its nature, its performance.
Put in order (整) + prepare (備): keep things in order and ready, maintenance.
Touch (接) + near (近): coming so near it almost touches, approaching.
Front (前) + back (後): front and back, before and after.
Mixed, rough (雑) cloth (巾): an everyday cloth for wiping floors.
Send (送) someone off at a parting (別): a farewell.
Send (送) + fee (料): the fee you pay to send something, postage.
属 means belong to a group: 属する is to belong to or be part of something.
Measure (測) and fix (定) the number: a measurement.
Plain (率) and straight (直): saying things directly, frank.
Big (大) + して, used with a negative: "not a big amount", so not very much.
Big (大) and small (小): together they mean size.
Body (体) + operate, work (操): working your body, physical exercise.
A big (大) part (分): considerably, a lot.
Standing (立) facing (対) each other: two sides in opposition.
Stand (立ち) + stop (止まる): you stop walking and stand still.
Collected (溜) breath (息): the breath you let out all at once, a sigh.
A group (団) of homes on one piece of land (地): a housing complex.
Cut off (断) doubt and fix (定) it: to decide firmly, a conclusion.
Your long, excellent (長) point (所): a strong point. Opposite: 短所, short point.
Directly (直) after (後): immediately following.
散 means scatter: 散らかす is to scatter things around and make a mess.
Pass through (通) and be used (用): accepted and usable everywhere.
繋 means tie or link: 繋がり is a link between things or people.
潰 means crush: 潰す is to smash flat, or to kill time (時間を潰す).
詰 means pack in tight: when too much is packed in, it gets blocked.
Stop (停) + stop (止): a double stop, a full stoppage.
Out (出) and in (入り): coming and going.
Put (入れ) your hands (手) into it: care and maintenance.
The neck (首) of the hand (手): your wrist.
Hand (手) steps that continue (続き) one after another: a procedure.
照 means shine light: 照らす is to shine light on something.
Spread out (展) and open (開): to unfold or develop.
See through (透) and clear, bright (明): transparent.
Specially (特) fixed (定): a specific, particular one.
Special (特) selling (売): a special sale.
The floor (床) space (間): a raised alcove in a Japanese room.
Take (取り) and bring out (出す): to take something out.
何 (what) + とも: "I can't say what it is", so really, extremely.
Day (日) use (用) goods (品): things you use every day.
鈍 has metal (金): a dull, blunt blade, and also a slow, dull mind.
Not remaining (残らず): nothing is left over, so all of it, without exception.
Ride (乗り) over, past (越し) your stop: riding past your station.
Same 鈍 (dull) as にぶい, but のろい means slow moving; のろのろ is "slowly".
Ash (灰) color (色): grey.
The feeling (気) of wanting to throw up (吐き): nausea.
挟 has a hand (扌): your hand holds something between two things.
At the start (始め): to begin with, first of all.
In the middle (中) of talking (話): the phone line is busy.
Broken (破) piece (片): a fragment.
Needle (針) metal (金): thin metal like a needle, wire.
Reflect (映) back (反): an image reflected back, or something that shows an influence.
Pull (引き) out (出す): pull out a drawer, or take money out of the bank.
Judge (評) and discuss (論): a critique or review.
広い (wide) + さ (how much): how wide it is, the extent.
Widely (普) reach (及): something spreads to everyone.
更 (further, late at night, as in 夜更け): the night goes further on, it gets late.
Blowing (吹) snow (雪): a snowstorm.
Swing (振り) to face (向く) another way: to turn around.
Divide (分) and undo (解): take apart, break down.
The body, form (体) of the writing (文): writing style.
Flat, calm (平) feeling (気): cool and calm, "I'm fine".
Separate (別), written twice (々 repeats it): each one separately.
Direction (方) + angle, corner (角): which way, a direction.
Area (方, as in 地方) + words (言): the way people talk in one area, a dialect.
Direction (方) needle (針): like a compass needle, a policy shows the way.
Wrap (包) + band, belt (帯): a band you wrap around a wound.
解 means undo: ほどく is to undo a knot or untie.
Street (街) corner (角): a street corner.
The very (真っ) front, tip (先): the very first.
Full (満) points (点): a perfect score.
Look (見) up (上げる): to look up at, or look up to someone.
Watch (見) as you send (送る) them off: to see someone off.
見掛ける means to catch sight of: 見掛け is what you see at first, the outward look.
Your body's (身) share, place (分): your position or status in society.
Not yet (未) full (満): less than; 18歳未満 means under 18.
Point (指す) your eyes (目) at it: to aim for a goal.
目 (eye, mark) + 安 (easy): an easy mark to check against, a rough guide.
Excused from (免) tax (税): tax free.
A thing (物) you hold up (差し) against something to measure it: a ruler.
Play (遊) garden (園) land (地): an amusement park.
Mail (郵) + send (送): to send by post.
Like letting the lamp oil (油) run out, cut off (断): a careless moment.
翌 means the next one: 翌日 is the next day, 翌年 the next year.
Wild, messy (乱) + violent (暴): rough and violent behaviour.
Both (両) sides (側): both sides.
Facing (臨) the time (時), just for now: temporary, special.
Your turn (番) to watch the house while people are away (留守): house sitting.
割 (ratio, compared): 割と means "compared to what you expect", fairly, quite.
泊 has water (氵): a boat stops at shore for the night; 二泊 is two nights.
再 means again: 再開 is to open again.
低 means low: 低温 is low temperature, 低価格 is low price.
位 means rank, a person (亻) standing (立) in their place: 一位 is first place.
通り is the road you pass along (通る): a street, or "along the lines of", as said.
隙 is a small gap: a gap in your guard, a chance for someone else.
我 means I, we, self: 我が国 is our country.
史 means history: 日本史 is Japanese history.
辛い (painful) after a verb: painful to do, hard to do; 読みづらい is hard to read.
切れ means cut off, run out: 時間切れ is time cut off, out of time.
防 means protect against: 防水 is waterproof, 防犯 is crime prevention.
向け comes from 向く (to face): made facing a group; 子供向け is for children.
羽 means feather, wing: so you count birds (and rabbits, by tradition) with 羽.
巻 means roll: old books were scrolls you rolled, so 巻 counts volumes.
省 is a government ministry: 外務省 is the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
条 means a line, an article: 第九条 is Article 9 of a law.
畳 is a tatami mat: 六畳 is a room the size of six mats.
各 means each: 各国 is each country.
省 also means cut down, save: 省エネ is saving energy.
非 means not, wrong: 非常識 is lacking common sense.
未 means not yet: 未完成 is not yet finished.
遣う means to use: 言葉遣い is the way you use words, 無駄遣い is wasting money.
Two jade pieces (王王) over 今 (giving the sound きん): a fine string instrument, a zither.
総 means all, whole: 総数 is the total number.
爪 is a picture of a hand reaching down with claws: your nails.
Metal (金) + 同 (sound どう): copper; 銅メダル is the bronze medal.
殿 means palace, lord: writing 殿 after a name honours them, like Mr.
丼 looks like a well (井) with food dropped in: a bowl of rice with food on top.
蓋 has grass (艹) on top: something that covers the top, a lid.
Wood (木) + 冘: old Japanese pillows were wooden blocks for your head.
Mountain (山) + 甲 (shell, armour): hard land that sticks out into the sea, a cape.
紫 has thread (糸): thread dyed purple, an old royal colour.
帳 has cloth (巾): sheets bound into a book; 手帳 is a notebook, 通帳 a bankbook.
等 means rank, grade: 一等 is first class, first prize.
等 means "and others": 彼等 (かれら) is he and the others, they.
続く means continue: 雨が続く, the rain goes on.
難 means difficult: 信じ難い is hard to believe.
刊 means publish: 朝刊 is the morning paper, 週刊 is weekly.
領 means rule over land: 日本領 is Japanese territory.
副 means second, sub: 副社長 is the vice president of a company.
系 has thread (糸): a line of connected things, a system or group; 理系 is science.
沿 has water (氵): following along a river; 川沿い is along the river.
Number (番) + 目 (the ~th): 三番目 is the third one.
御 makes words polite: 御中 (おんちゅう) is written after a company name on letters.
式 means style, method: 日本式 is Japanese style.
圏 is inside a box (囗): a closed area; 首都圏 is the capital area.
Hour (時間) + 目 (the ~th): 二時間目 is second period at school.
過ぎる means go past: go past the limit, too much; 食べ過ぎる is eat too much.
艘 has boat (舟): counts boats; 一艘 is one boat.
庁 has a roof (广): a government office; 気象庁 is the weather agency.
兆 means sign, omen, and also trillion: 一兆円 is one trillion yen.
丁 counts town blocks + 目 (the ~th): 三丁目 is the 3rd block in an address.
滴 has water (氵): a drop of water; 一滴 is one drop.
遍 means all over, times: 一遍 is once, 何遍も is many times.
扇 is a fan, a door (戸) with feathers (羽): to fan yourself.
呆 looks like a mouth (口) on a tree (木), mouth open in shock: to be appalled.
Until (まで) you are fed up (飽く): to the very end, stubbornly.
明 (bright): when it gets light, the next day comes; 明くる日 is the next day.
憧 has heart (忄): your heart longs for something, to admire.
Morning (朝) sleep (寝) boy (坊): a boy who sleeps late, oversleeping.
Thick (厚) skinned: so bold you feel no shame, cheeky.
Press (圧) and shrink (縮): compress.
The name (名) it is sent to (宛): the address on a letter.
It hits (当て) and fits in (はまる): to apply, to fit a category.
Hit (当て) and fit it in (はめる): to apply a rule to something.
暴 means violent: 暴れる is to act wildly, to rage.
Rain (雨) + door (戸): the door you shut against the rain.
甘い (sweet) + やかす: being too sweet with a child, spoiling them.
余 means extra: 余る is to be left over.
Knitted (編み) things (物): knitting.
編 has thread (糸): you knit threads together.
危 means danger (as in 危ない): 危うい is dangerous, at risk.
荒 has grass (艹): wild, overgrown land, so rough and wild.
粗 has rice (米): rice not finely ground, so coarse, rough.
Rough (粗) lines (筋): the rough outline of a story, a synopsis.
改 means change, reform: 改める is to change for the better, revise.
Hard (難) to have (有): something rare, so you are thankful (ありがとう).
荒 means wild: 荒れる is when weather or a place becomes rough or wild.
慌 has heart (忄): a panicked heart, so busy and hurried.
Say (言い) and attach (付ける) a task: to tell someone to do it, to order.
Meaning (意) + right, reason (義): the meaning or value of something.
Alive (生き) + alive (生き): full of life, lively.
幾 means how many, some: 幾つ is how many, 幾日 is several days.
Some (幾) part (分): somewhat, a little.
Living (生け) flowers (花): the art of flower arranging.

From 切る (to cut): a knife that cuts well, or a rope that snaps and breaks.
Forbid (禁) smoke (煙): no smoking here.
Bitter suffering (苦) plus pain (痛): real agony.
Divide into areas (区) and keep separate (別): telling things apart.
Teach (訓) and drill until polished (練): training and practice.
Decide (決) in your heart (心): firm determination.
Missing (欠) from your seat (席): being absent from class.
The present (現) state (状): how things are right now.
The effect (効) gives fruit (果): the result something has.
High (高) value (価): expensive. Same sound as 効果, so watch the kanji.
School (校) plus building (舎): the school building.
The later (後) one (者): the latter of two things. Opposite of 前者.
Your country (国) on the register (籍): your nationality.
Bone (骨) plus break (折): a fractured bone.
A small (小) thing you wrap (包): a parcel in the post.
Mixed (混) and jumbled (雑): a crowded, congested place.
Mixed (混) and in disorder (乱): total chaos and confusion.
The most (最) low (低): the lowest, or simply the worst.
さけぶ sounds like 'Sake! Boo!': a drunk fan shouting loudly at the game.
Lost in a maze (迷): you are lost or cannot decide which way to go.
A thing (事) worth seeing (見): splendid, wonderful to look at.
The bright (明) day (日) after (後) tomorrow: like 明日 but one day later.
向 means direction: to turn and face that way.
Steamed (蒸し) and hot (暑い): hot, humid summer weather in Japan.
Bright (明) and certain (確): very clear and definite.
A name (名) word (詞): a noun, the word that names a thing.
A famous (名) person (人): a master or expert at something.
Things (物) and matters (事): everything in life.
やっかい sounds like 'yuck, eh?': a troublesome thing you wish you did not have.
Excellent (優) and outstanding (秀): a top student.
The feeling (情) between friends (友): friendship.
The needed (要) points (点): the main points, the gist.
The middle (中) of the world (世): society, the world we live in.
Benefit (利) plus gain (益): profit.
Under one roof (宀 on top), many students live together: a dormitory.
Outside (外) the usual example (例): an exception to the rule.
分 shows a knife cutting something in two: to divide or separate.
A section (課) with a topic (題): a task or assignment you must work on.
From 狩る (to hunt): 狩 has the dog radical, a hunter goes out with his dog.
Enjoy (享) and receive (受): to enjoy something you were given, like freedom or a right.
Warp (経) and weft (緯) threads: how events were woven together, the full story.
A person (人) from the old days (故): someone who has passed away.
Set up (設) and prepared (備): the equipment and facilities of a place.
Keep things in moderation (節) and tight (約): saving money.
善 means good: the opposite of 悪 (evil).
Specialize (専) and attack (攻) one subject: your university major.
The earlier (前) one (者): the former of two. Opposite of 後者.
Announce (宣) and spread (伝) the word: advertising and publicity.
Loss (損) plus harm (害): damage you suffer.
Stay put (滞) and be there (在): a stay somewhere, like at a hotel.
Big (大) thing: 大したもの means something great; 大したことない means no big deal.
Facing (対) an image (象): the target or object you aim at or study.
The great (大) one who controls (統) and leads (領) the nation: the president.
Replace (代) and manage (理): someone acting for you, a deputy or proxy.
互 looks like two hooks gripping each other: mutual, each other.
From 確か (certain): you check to make sure something is true.
Many (多) or few (少): some amount, a little.
From 戦う (to fight): 戦 has the 戈 halberd, a weapon for battle.
達 means reach: to reach a goal or a number.
Other (他) person (人): a stranger, someone not related to you.
A single (単) position (位): one unit, or one course credit at school.
A group (団) as one body (体): an organization.
Your place (位) on the ground (地): your status in society.
A piece of land (地) divided into wards (区): a district.
Pass through (通) and go (行): passing along a road.
通 means pass through: a road leads somewhere, or your words get through.
Pass through (通) a message or trust (信): communications.
Stick (付き) together (合い): keeping company with friends or colleagues.
付 is a hand (寸) touching a person (亻): to stick or be attached.
Make it stick (付): to attach or add something, like turning on a light.
Go out (出) and meet (会): an encounter, meeting someone new.
Suitable (適) and cut (切) just right: appropriate for the situation.
鉄 has the metal radical (金): iron, the metal trains and bridges are made of.
An iron (鉄) road (道): the railway.
A model rule (典) cast in a mould (型): a typical example.
Same (同) one (一): exactly the same thing, identical.
Same (同) kind or manner (様): just like, the same way.
Alone (独) in body (身): single, not married.
Untie (解) a knot: it comes undone, or a problem is solved.
流 means flow: to make water or tears flow away.
半 means half: halfway or the middle, like 九月半ば (mid September).
眺 has the eye (目): to look out at the view for a long time.
悩 has the heart (忄) and a brain part: your heart and head are troubled.
Resembles (似) and matches (合う): clothes that suit you.
Enter (入) the place (場): admission, like an entry ticket.
願 has the head (頁): bow your head and wish or ask, お願いします.
Farming (農) as your work (業): agriculture.
幅 has the cloth (巾): how wide a piece of cloth is, width.
The place (場) you see on the surface (面): a scene in a story or film.
A pattern or limit (範) that surrounds (囲) it: the range or scope.
Commit (犯) a wrong (罪): a crime.
Turn back (反) and look at yourself (省): reflecting on what you did wrong.
Flat (平) and equal grade (等): everyone treated the same, equality.
防 means defend: to block something bad, like stopping a cold.
Not (不) to your benefit (利): a disadvantage.
Fog (雰) that surrounds (囲) you, plus air (気): the mood of a place.
Divided (分) fields (野): an area or field of study.
Flat (平) and level (均): the average, everything evened out.
Flat and calm (平) plus harmony (和): peace.
Plentiful (豊) and rich (富): lots of something.
Direction (方) repeated (々): in all directions, everywhere.
A walking (歩) path (道): the sidewalk for people on foot.
全 means whole: completely, totally. まったく! also means 'Honestly!' when annoyed.
Point (指) and wave (揮) your hand: a conductor directing an orchestra, command.
Decline (辞) and step back (退): politely refusing an offer.
The true (正) body (体): someone's real identity behind the mask.
継 has thread (糸): you tie on and continue the line, taking over the family business.
Turn (転) to a new school (校): changing schools.
Pass on (伝) words (言): a message you leave for someone.
Keep safe (保) and guard (護): protection, like protecting animals.
Holding (もって) it before (前): done beforehand, in advance.
咳 has the mouth (口): せき, the sound of a cough coming out.
稲 has the grain radical (禾): the rice plant in the paddy field.
蚊 has the insect radical (虫): か, the small buzzing mosquito.
岸 has the mountain (山) and a cliff (厂): the steep bank or shore.
旧 has the sun (日): many old days ago. 旧 means old or former, ex-.
Think of てき as 'tackle': the enemy who tackles you, your rival.
びん sounds like 'bin': throw the glass bottle in the bin.
幕 has the cloth (巾): the big curtain on a stage.
版 has the wood board (片): a printing block, so one edition of a book.
さる sounds like 'Sarah': Sarah the monkey swings from tree to tree.
州 shows islands in a river (川 with dots): land between rivers, a state.
銃 has the metal radical (金): a gun, a weapon made of metal.
Wind (風) on the mountain (山): a storm.
陰 has the hill (阝): the shady side of a hill, out of the sun.
籠 has bamboo (竹) on top: a basket or cage woven from bamboo.
鐘 has metal (金): the big metal bell at a temple. かね is also money, both metal.
革 is a stretched animal hide: leather, like 革の靴 (leather shoes).
癖 has the sickness radical (疒): a bad habit you cannot cure.
訓 has words (言): the native Japanese word used to read a kanji, kun reading.
綿 has thread (糸) and white (白): white cotton thread.
綿 has thread (糸) and white (白): soft white cotton wool, わた.
菌 has the grass radical (艹): tiny living things like mould, germs.
肌 has the flesh radical (月): your skin.
仏 is a person (亻): the Buddha, a person who became enlightened.
堀 has earth (土): dig the earth to make a moat around a castle.
脳 has the flesh radical (月): the brain inside your head.
班 shows a knife (刂) cutting jade (王) in two: split into small groups.
The way (法) of doing (作) things: good manners and etiquette.
様 means kind or manner, doubled (々): many kinds, various.
覚 means wake up and notice: you wake up from sleep.
去 means go away, like 過去 (the past, gone by): to leave.
Join in (参) and think (考): something you use for reference.
Sour (酸) nature (性): acidity, like lemon juice.
The sour (酸) element (素): oxygen (its old name means 'acid maker').
Jet (ジェット) plus machine (機): a jet plane.
Arriving at (至) hurry (急): extremely urgent, right now.
Kill (殺) oneself (自): suicide.
Payment (支) going out (出): expenses, money you spend.
沈 has water (氵): to sink under water, or to feel low.
親 means parent or close: as close as family, intimate.
Lose (失) your work (業): unemployment.
Damp (湿) air (気): humidity, moisture in the air.
Actually (実) carry out (施): putting a plan into action.
Damp (湿) degree (度): how humid it is, as a number.
Child (児) plus child (童): children, especially school kids.
Die (死) and be lost (亡): death, an official word.
Money (資) as the base (本): capital to start a business.
The taste (味) of earth (地): plain and modest, not flashy.
The main teaching (宗) you are taught (教): religion.
Fix (修) to make right (正): correcting a mistake.
Heavy (重) body (体): a body in serious condition, critically ill.
Sluggish (渋) and stuck (滞): a traffic jam. Same sound as 重体!
Gather (集) into a group (団): a mass of people.
Main (主) principle (義): an -ism, like 資本主義 (capitalism).
Lodge (宿) and stay the night (泊): hotel accommodation.
The head (首) city (都): the capital.
The main (主) woman (婦) of the home: housewife.
Main (主) and needed (要): chief, most important.
Things you need (需) and want (要): demand, as in supply and demand.
In order (順) and in tune (調): everything going smoothly.
A block (障) that does harm (害): an obstacle, or a disability.
Go up (上) to the capital (京): moving to Tokyo.
Exactly (正) the hour of the horse (午): 12 noon, as in 午前 and 午後.
A little (少) woman (女): a young girl.
Go up (上) and reach (達) a higher level: improving at a skill.
Upper (上) grade (等): first class, excellent quality.
Rush into (衝) and crash suddenly (突): a collision.
Leave out (省) and shorten (略): an abbreviation.
Woman (女) king (王): a queen. Note the reading じょおう.
Eating (食) things (物): food.
Food (食) and grain (糧): food supplies.
A writing (書) room (斎): your study at home.
徐 means slowly, doubled (々): little by little.
Sign (署) your name (名): a signature.
Written (書) things (物): books.
Know (知) each other (合い): an acquaintance.
Divine (神) pathways (経): nerves, the lines carrying signals in your body.
Believe (信) in and look up (仰) to a god: your faith.
Carved (刻) deep (深): a problem that cuts deep is serious.
People (人) sorted by type, like seeds (種): race.
Body (身) + body (体): the whole body, said formally.
Body (身) length (長): how tall you are.
Examine (審) and judge (判): the referee decides who wins.
Water (水) always finds a flat level (準): a level or standard.
進 means advance (like 進む): you push something forward.
Head (頭) pain (痛): a headache.
全 means whole, all: すべて is everything.
済 means finished, settled (like 済む): get something done and over with.
鋭 has metal (金) on the left: a sharp, pointed blade.
Brush past (すれ) going in different (違) directions: pass each other.
The place (所) where the doing (為) started: the cause, whose fault it is.
Request (請) and demand (求): a claim or bill for money.
Clean (清) and pure (潔): spotlessly clean.
Nature (性) + quality (質): what something is like inside.
A person (人) who has become (成) grown up: an adult.
Even with all your energy (精), that's the most you can do: at best.
Make (製) and build (造): manufacture in a factory.
Life (生) getting long (長): a plant growing taller.
Birth (生) year (年) month (月) day (日): your date of birth.
Life (生) + life, fate (命): life itself.
Stone (石) charcoal (炭): coal, black rock that burns.
Love (愛) + feelings (情): warm affection.
愛 is love: 愛する means to love.
Evil (悪) + demon (魔): the devil.
与 means give (like 給与, salary): to give or grant.
争 means fight, compete (like 戦争, war): to argue or fight.
哀 means sorrow (like 哀しい): something so sad it is pitiful.
Outside (外) your plan (案): it happened unexpectedly.
Write it down (記) in your head, even in the dark (暗): learn by heart.
Peaceful (安) and fixed (定): stable.
Tie (維) and hold (持) it in place: keep it going, maintain.
A bad (悪) disposition (意地): mean and nasty.
Great (偉) and big (大): greatness.
In one (一) time (度): all at once.
One (一) house (家): the whole family.
One (一) body (体): one unit; also used for 'what on earth?'
Brothers (兄弟) one step down (従) the family tree: your male cousin.
Sisters (姉妹) one step down (従): your female cousins.
Differ from (違) and go against (反) the rules: a violation.
Garment (衣) + clothes (服): clothing.
祝 means celebrate (like 祝日, a public holiday): to celebrate.
If (ば) you were to say (言わ) it: so to speak.
A stamp (印) of an image (象) left in your mind: an impression.
Pull (引) out someone's words and use (用) them: a quotation.
訴 has words (言) on the left: use words to complain, appeal or sue.
奪 means snatch: to rob, to take away.
Cut (切) someone from behind (裏): betray them.
羨 means envy: うらやましい, I'm jealous of you.
Eternal (永) and far away (遠): forever.
Eternal (永) and long lasting (久): permanent.
A guard (衛) star (星): a satellite that circles and watches a planet.
描 has a hand (扌): draw or depict a picture.
Cut (断) across sideways (横): crossing a road.
大 means big: in a big way, greatly.
起 means rise (like 起きる): something rises up, it happens.
Sound hook: 'Oh, sharp!': someone dressed sharp and stylish.
喋 has a mouth (口): someone whose mouth never stops, chatter.
恐 means fear: 'I fear that...', so perhaps, probably.
Warm (温) + warm (暖): a mild, warm climate.
Meet (会) and come together (合): a meeting.
Mixing (交) with the outside (外) world: diplomacy.
Open (開) + begin (始): the start.
Untie (解) and explain (釈): how you interpret something.
Go out (出) outside (外): going out.
Study (学) of change (化): chemistry, how things change into other things.
描 has a hand (扌): to draw; sounds like 書く (write).
隠 means hide: to conceal something.
Spread (拡) out big (大): enlarge, zoom in.
Study (学) and ask questions (問): learning, scholarship.
Add (加) and subtract (減): adjust until it's just right.
硬 has stone (石): hard as a stone.
Each piece (片) gets attached (付く) to its place: tidied up, settled.
Lively (活) use (用): put to practical use; also verb conjugation.
Temporarily (仮) fixed (定): an assumption.
Lessons (課) taken in set stages (程): a course of study.
The hairs (毛) of your head hair (髪): the hair on your head.
Department (科) item (目): a school subject.
Song (歌) + chant (謡): a popular song or ballad.
Looks like (そう) it needs love (可愛): poor thing.
Can (可) be loved (愛): lovely, sweet.
Check (勘) and settle (定): count up the bill.
Complete (完) and finished (了): done.
Member (員) of the debate (議): a member of parliament.
Tool (器) + machine (械): an instrument.
Debate (議) meeting (会): parliament.
効 means effect (like 効果): the medicine works.
Skill (技) master (師): an engineer.
Air (気) body (体): a gas.
Return (帰) home (宅): getting home.
Noble (貴) and weighty (重): precious, valuable.
Head (長) of the debate (議): the chairman.
Poison (毒) to your spirit (気): what a pity.
Sudden (急) and violent (激): sharp and sudden.
Suck in (吸) and take in (収): absorb.
Rest (休) and breathe (息): relaxation.
Conduct (行) + ceremony (儀): manners.
Teach (教) and give (授) knowledge: a professor.
Strong (強) tone (調): emphasis.
Fear (恐) + fright (怖): terror.
Strong (強) power (力): powerful.
Money (金) + coins (銭): cash.
Things belonging (属) to the metal (金) group: metal.
The near (近) era (代): modern times.
Sinew (筋) + flesh (肉): muscle.
Money (金) melting and flowing (融) around: finance.
食 is eat: a rough, casual way to say eat.
臭 means bad smell: 'Kusai!' it stinks.
下 means down: to go down.
Group (組) together (合): a union.
Reel it in (繰り) and send it back (返す): do it again and again.
苦 means suffering, bitter: to suffer.
加 means add: to be added, to join in.
Army (軍) squad (隊): troops.
Respect (敬) in your mind (意): respect.
Lean (傾) toward (向) something: a tendency.
Warn (警) and tell (告): a warning.
Put up (掲) and show (示): a notice on a board.
Pass through (経) by way of (由): via.
Change (化) and adorn (粧) your face: makeup.
Blood (血) liquid (液): blood.
Lacking (欠) + a pit to fall in (陥): a defect.
See (見) and understand (解): your point of view.
Money (金) present (現) in your hand: cash.
Appear (現) + exist (在): what exists now, the present.
An image (象) that appears (現): a phenomenon.
Build (建) and set up (設): construction.
Constitution (憲) + law (法): the constitution.
濃 has water (氵): a thick, strong drink or colour.
Happy (幸) luck (運): good luck.
Hard (硬) money (貨): a coin.
Grand (豪) + flowery (華): luxurious.
Sail (航) through the sky (空): aviation.
Attack (攻) + strike (撃): an attack.
Tribute (貢) + offering (献): a contribution.
Mix (交) with people on occasions (際): friendship, dating.
Public (公) and correct (正): fair, just.
Build (構) and form (成): how something is put together.
High (高) speed (速).
A thief (盗) using strength (強): a robber.
Happiness (幸) + good fortune (福).
Public (公) and flat, even (平): fair.
Think (考) + consider (慮): take into account.
Overcome (克) and make it submit (服): conquer a problem.
Grain (穀) things (物): cereals.
Pepper (椒) from foreign lands (胡): black pepper.
A country (国) as one house (家): the nation.
Country (国) boundary (境): a national border.
異 means different: to differ.
Small (小) building (屋): a hut.
Now (今) and after (後): from now on.
Troubled (困) + difficult (難): hardship.
Marriage (婚) promise (約): engagement.
Wealth (財) you produce (産): property.
Judge (裁) and decide (判): a trial.
Things (物) you make, grow (作): crops.
指 is finger: point at it.
誘 has words (言): use words to invite or tempt.
Make (作) a tune (曲): compose music.
Sand (砂) that's vast (漠): a desert.
Difference (差) + separate (別): treating people differently, discrimination.
One (一) in ten thousand (万): if by any chance.
Watch (見) and send off (送り): seeing someone off.
方 means side: the person on your side, an ally.
No (無) looking (視): ignore.
Bug (虫) tooth (歯): a cavity, as if bugs ate it.
寧 means rather: むしろ, I'd rather do this instead.
Name (名) + card (刺): a business card.
Sound hook: 'I met a (めった) ghost? Rarely!': seldom, used with a negative verb.
Say (申し) and push in (込む): apply for something.
尤 means indeed, naturally: quite right, that makes sense.
基 means base (like 基本): to be based on.
Thing (物) sound (音): a noise.
Model (模) + style (様): a pattern or design.
破 means tear, break: tear paper, break a rule, beat a rival.
Friend (友) + like (好): friendship.
Have (有) ability (能): capable.
Have (有) the advantage (利): advantageous.
Pleasant (愉) + cheerful (快): fun, happy.
易 means easy (like 簡易): easy, simple.
Need (要) and seek (求): a demand.
要 means the main point: in short.
Key (要) + element (素): an element.
Expect (期) in advance (予): expectation.
Measure (測) in advance (予): predict.
Extra (余) portion (分): surplus.
Defend (防) in advance (予): prevention.
因 means cause (like 原因): to come from, be due to.
Sharp (利) mouth (口): clever.
Separate (離) the marriage (婚): divorce.
Reason (理) + idea (想): an ideal.
Swap (替) both (両) ways: change money.
Courtesy (礼) + ceremony (儀): good manners.
A line (列) of cars (車): a train.
Link (連) + continue (続): one after another, in a row.
Argue (論) + fight (争): a dispute.
僅 means a tiny bit: only a little.
割 means divide (like 割引, discount): to split or break.
Medicine (医) + institution (院): the small doctor's building near your home, a clinic.
As before (依) + as it is (然): nothing has changed, still, as yet.
One (一) belt (帯) of land: the whole area around a place.
A different (異) move (動): being moved to another post at work, a transfer.
Clothes (衣) + materials (料): clothing and the cloth to make it.
織 has thread (糸) on the left: you weave threads into cloth.
欠 means missing (as in 欠席, absence): to lack something, or to chip off a piece.
Study (学) + history (歴): your history of schools, your academic background.
Add (加) taste (味): adding flavour, seasoning.
Publish (刊) + go out (行): sending a book or magazine out, publication.
Used to (慣, as in 慣れる) + doing (行): something people are used to doing, a custom.
Government official (官) + colleague (僚): officials working together to run the state, bureaucrats.
Tool (器) + official job (官): a body part with its own job, an organ.
Season (季) + publish (刊): published once a season, quarterly.
Rise (起) + source (源): where something rises from, its origin.
Machine (機) + structure (構): how the parts are built together, a mechanism or organisation.
Rule (規) + control (制): controlling things with rules, regulation.
Hill (丘) + mound (陵): hills and more hills, hilly land.
Together (協) + discuss (議): sitting down together to talk it over, a conference.
Together (協) + tune (調): playing in tune together, cooperation and harmony.
Near (近) + sight (視): you only see near things clearly, nearsighted.
Measure (計) + tool (器): a tool for measuring, a meter or gauge.
Shape (形) + condition (態): the shape and state of something, its form.
Blood (血) + pipe (管): the pipes that carry blood, blood vessels.
Decide (決) + carry out (行): you decided, so now you do it, even in the rain.
Decrease (減) + few (少): it gets smaller and fewer, a decline.
Sail (航) + sea (海): sailing across the sea, a voyage.
Seize (拘) + tie in a bundle (束): grabbed and tied up, restrained.
Wild (荒) + abandoned (廃): left to go wild and fall apart, ruin.
Come down (降) + lie face down (伏): you get down on the ground and give up, surrender.
Rise up (興) + stirred up (奮): your feelings rise and burst out, excitement.
Word (語) + phrase (句): words and phrases.
Individual (個) repeated (々): each one, one by one.
Small (小) + coin money (銭): small change, coins.
Pick (採) + gather (集): picking things and collecting them, like bugs or plants.
Cut off (絶) + destroy (滅): completely wiped out, extinct.
Wash (洗) + chemical agent (剤): the stuff you wash with, detergent.
Whole (全) + body (身): the whole body, head to toe.
Forward (前) + advance (進): moving forward, progress.

Hand (扌) + nail (丁): a hand hitting a nail, to hit.
例 means example: for example.
変 means change: something changes by itself.
From (以) + outside (外): outside of this, other than.
負 means to carry a burden (貝 below is money): you take the loss, to lose.
Hand (手) + pass on (伝): pass along a hand, to help.
Bamboo (竹) on top: bamboo bending in the wind like a person laughing.
Writing (文) + study (学): the study of writing, literature.
Bow (拝) + see (見): look at something with a bow, humbly see.
Heavy (重) + power (力): power moves heavy things, to move.
A picture of a small creature with a big head: an insect.
Turn, number (番) + group (組): a group of shows in turn, a TV program.
程 means degree or limit (as in 程度): to that extent.
A picture of a small boat: a boat.
Mouth (口) + empty (虚): empty words from the mouth, a lie.
Medicine (医) + study (学): medical science.
Heart (心) at the bottom: your heart boils over, to get angry.
Road radical (⻌): running away down the road, to escape.
Between (間) + different (違): picking the different one, to make a mistake.
行 means go and also do: to carry out, to do.
Plain, pure (素) + clear sky (晴): pure like a sunny day, wonderful.
Bird (隹) + road (⻌): a bird only flies forward, to advance.
Subject (科) + study (学): studying subject by subject, science.
Teach (教) + raise (育): teaching and raising children, education.
特 means special (as in 特別): especially.
Release (放) + send (送): sending signals out, broadcasting.
Hand radical (扌): your hand hands over money, to pay.
Water (水) + swim (泳): swimming.
下 (down): to lower something.
Eye radical (目): closing your eyes, to sleep.
代 means generation or period: 20代 is your twenties.
Earth (土) + 反 (turn back): earth turned up, a slope.
Free, loose (漫) + picture (画): free fun pictures, comics.
比 shows two people side by side: put things side by side, to compare.
Send out (発) + sound (音): sending out sounds, pronunciation.
Give (贈り) + thing (物): a thing you give, a present; 贈 has 貝 (money, value).
Altar radical (礻): praying at the altar, to pray.
Person (人) + shape (形): a person shape, a doll.
Ear (耳) + heart (心): your ears go red and your heart beats, embarrassed.
Two trees (木木): a small wood.
Fight (戦) + compete (争): fighting and competing, war.
Suit (適) + hit (当): hits the mark well, suitable; in speech it often means careless.
Sentence (文) + rule (法): sentence rules, grammar.
治 means cure: an illness gets cured, to get better.
From (以) + below (下): this and below, less than.
Make, birth (生) + produce (産): to produce.
為 means for the sake of: ため, for, in order to.
Person (亻) + 云 (say): a person passes on what was said, to tell.
Tool, details (具) + fit (合): how the parts fit together, condition.
Stay (駐) + car (車) + place (場): a place where cars stay, a parking lot.
See (見) + attach (つける): see it and fix your eyes on it, to find.
Body radical (月, flesh): a body part, the arm.
Accept (承) + know (知): I know and I accept, consent.
Road (⻌) + army (軍): armies carry supplies along roads, to carry.
See (見) + dance (舞い): you visit a sick friend and cheer them up, a get-well visit.
下 (down): to go down, to drop.
Leave, retreat (退) + institution (院): leave the hospital.
Thread radical (糸): a thread goes on and on, to continue.
Eye radical (目), same kanji as 眠る (sleep): sleepy eyes, sleepy.
Do (仕) + way (方): the way of doing it, method.
Tree (木) + straight (直): put a tree in the ground straight, to plant.
Both (両) + side (方): both sides.
Compete (競) + fight (争): competition.
Woman (女) + joy (喜): a joyful woman, happy.
畳 means to fold or pile up: woven mats laid in layers on the floor, tatami.
Tree (木) + branch (支): a tree branch.
Floor (床) + shop (屋): old barbers worked in a shop with a raised floor.
Roof radical (宀): a house; お宅 is a polite word for someone's home.
Outskirts (郊) + outside (外): outside the city, the suburbs.
Building (屋) + top (上): the top of the building, the rooftop.
建 means build, as in 建物 (building): to build.
Double, many (複) + mixed (雑): many things mixed up, complicated.
通 means pass through: to pass by, to go through.
Middle (中) + school (学校): middle school, junior high.
盛 means heap up (dish 皿 at the bottom): a heaped dish, thriving.
Go out (出) + seat (席): go out to your seat, attendance.
Horn (角) + insect (虫): a bug touches things with its antennae, to touch.
Goods (品) + thing (物): goods.
足 means foot and also enough: to be enough.
光 means light: to shine.
Know (知る) + make (せる): make someone know, to notify.
Tooth (歯) + doctor (医) + person (者): the tooth doctor, a dentist.
Water (水) + road (道): the road water takes to your tap.
From (以) this line, inside (内) it: within, no more than.
細 has thread (糸) on the left: thin threads are small and fine.
The main (主) person (人) of the house: her husband.
育 means to grow: you help a child grow, so you raise them.
味 means taste: miso is the paste that gives soup its taste.
Beckon (招) someone and wait (待) for them: an invitation.
An evil (邪) demon (魔) standing in your way: a hindrance, a nuisance.
Country (国) + edge, meeting point (際): where countries meet, international.
A person (亻) goes to the official (司): humbly visiting or asking.
Again (再) + next (来) week (週): next week, then once more, the week after next.
Electric (電) + lamp (灯): an electric light.
空 is the empty sky: a seat or room becomes empty, it あく.
Someone who holds (持ち) lots of money (金): a rich person.
Government (政) + rule (治): politics.
空 is the empty sky: a train with few people is すいている.
This (この) gap (間) of time: the other day, recently.
向 means facing a direction: you face something and go towards it.
移 has grain (禾): move rice plants to a new field, to move or shift.
急 has a heart (心) at the bottom: your heart races when you hurry.
Fit (合う) into the gap (間) of time: to make it in time.
Words (言) + direction (方): go in someone's direction to talk, to visit.
毛 looks like a tuft of hair with a few strands: hair or fur.
様 means manner, style: a polite way to address someone, like Mr. or Ms.
すみ sounds like "sue me!", shouted by a kid sent to stand in the corner (隅).
生 means life, a plant growing from the ground: to live.
Grass (艹) + old (古): old herbs taste bitter.
止 means stop: the rain stops, 雨が止む.
Before (予) + learn (習): study before class, preparing lessons.
Not (非) normal (常): so much that it is not normal, extremely.
焼 has fire (火) on the left: put it on the fire to grill or bake.
壊 has earth (土): an earth wall falls apart, it breaks.
起 has run (走): make someone get up and run, wake them up.
浅 has water (氵): water that is not deep, shallow.
迎 has the road part (辶): go out on the road to meet and welcome someone.
捕 has a hand (扌): grab with your hand, to catch.
決 has water (氵): like water breaking through a dam, it is decided and fixed.
飾 has food (食): decorate the table with food for a party.
Cause (故) + obstacle (障): something gets in the way, a breakdown.
倍 has a person (亻): one person becomes two, double.
Hot (熱) heart (心): a burning heart, enthusiasm.
残 has bones (歹): only the bones are left, what remains.
立 is a person standing on the ground: make something stand up.
珍 has jewel (王, from 玉): a jewel is rare and unusual.
泊 has water (氵): a ship stays the night in the water at a port.
喜 has a drum (壴) and mouth (口): drum and sing, you are delighted.
School (校) + head, chief (長): the head of the school, the principal.
Cold (冷) + room (房): making a room cold, air conditioning.
Far (遠) + thought (慮): thinking far ahead, so you hold back.
One side (片) + attach (付ける): put things to one side, tidy up.
血 is a dish (皿) with a drop on top: blood in a bowl.
ずいぶん sounds like "zoom boom": things got very, very big.
尋 has hands (ヨ, 寸) and a mouth (口): reach out and ask a question.
Down (下): go down, get off from somewhere high.
Divide (割) + fit together (合): how the parts divide and fit, a ratio.
存 means to exist, to know: ご存じ is the polite "you know".
Steam (汽) + vehicle (車): a steam train.
A form (格) people like (好): your shape and look; かっこいい comes from it.
Polish (研) + investigate (究) + room (室): the room for research, a lab.
Return (復) + learn (習): go back over what you learned, review.
Stand (立つ) in a role (役): to be useful.
Plants (艹) that come up early (早): grass.
別 has a knife (刂): cut apart, to separate.
式 means style, form: a ceremony done in a set form.
喉 has a mouth (口) on the left: the part behind your mouth, the throat.
糸 looks like a twisted thread hanging down: thread.
君 once meant ruler (尹 + mouth 口); now you add くん for boys and juniors.
続 has thread (糸): a long thread goes on and on, keep doing.
始 has woman (女): a woman gives life, the start of something.
The big (大) part reaches (抵) it: most of the time, usually.
壊 has earth (土): you break down an earth wall.
Hand (扌) + come together (合): your fingers come together to pick something up.
Earth (地) + logic (理): how the earth is laid out, geography.
Use (用) + matter (事): a matter to take care of, an errand.
Stubborn (頑) + stretch (張る): stubbornly stretch yourself, try your best.
投 has a hand (扌): throw with your hand.
Again (再) + next (来) month (月): the month after next.
Fly (飛) + go (行) + place (場): the place you go to fly, an airport.
The gentle (柔) way (道): judo.
Red (赤) little boy (坊): a newborn baby is red in the face.
Words (辞) + book of rules (典): a book of words, a dictionary or reference book.
Food (食) + materials (料) + goods (品): food goods, groceries.
踊 has a foot (足): move your feet to dance.
塗 has water (氵) and earth (土): spread mud on a wall, to paint or plaster.
Public (公) + duty (務) + member (員): a member who does public work.
嬢 has woman (女): a young woman, someone's daughter.
Erase (消し) + rubber (ゴム, from Dutch gom): the rubber that erases.
Sea (海) + shore (岸): the coast.
Ride (乗り) + thing (物): a thing you ride, a vehicle.
Small (小) bird (鳥): a little bird.
Lower (下) + lodging (宿): a humble place to stay, a boarding house.
貿 has a shell (貝, old money) + exchange (易): swapping goods for money, trade.
申 means to say humbly: 申す is the humble way to say 言う.
亡 means dead, gone: a person is gone, passed away.
足 is foot, but also enough: add more until it is enough.
Teach (教) + meeting (会): a meeting where faith is taught, a church.
暮 has the sun (日) under grass (艹): the sun sinks into the grass, it gets dark.
Middle (中) and middle again (々), deeper and deeper in: quite, very; with a negative, not easily.
Lecture (講) + hall (堂): a hall for lectures, an auditorium.
Under (下) + wear (着): underwear.
Right (是) or wrong (非), whatever happens: by all means.
Branch (支) + measure (度): sort and measure things ahead, getting ready.
Big (大) body (体): the big body of it, roughly, in general.
Transport (輸) + enter (入): goods carried in, import.
Produce (産) + business (業): producing business, industry.
Special (特) + hurry (急): the special fast train.
Lecture (講) + meaning (義): explaining meanings, a lecture.
Warm (暖) + room (房): heating.
慣 has a heart (忄): your heart gets used to it.
Child (子) with polite お and さん: someone else's child.
Display (展) + look (覧) + meeting (会): an event to look at displays, an exhibition.
召 means summon: 召し上がる is the respectful way to say someone eats or drinks.
Pour (注) + shoot (射): shoot medicine into you, an injection.
冷 has ice (冫): it grows cold.
割 has a knife (刂): it splits, it breaks.
Craft, factory (工) + business (業): manufacturing industry.
汚 has water (氵): dirty water, to become dirty.
True (真) + middle (中): the exact middle, the center.
This (この) time (頃): these days.
Watch (看) + protect (護) + woman (婦): a woman who watches over patients, a nurse.
See (見) + things (物): going to see things, sightseeing.
陰 means shade: in someone's shade (protection), thanks to them.
Tree (木) + cotton (綿): cotton from a plant, read もめん.
Transport (輸) + go out (出): goods sent out, export.
Big (大) part (分): a large part, quite a lot.
Electric (電) + report (報): a message by wire, a telegram.
Inside (内) the house (家): an old word for one's wife, who keeps the home.
億 has a person (亻): more people than you can imagine, a hundred million.
製 has clothes (衣): clothes made in a place, made in ~.
軒 means the edge of a roof: count houses by their roofs.
区 is a box (匚) with a mark inside: a section of a city, a ward.
絹 has thread (糸): fine thread from silkworms, silk.
Study (学) + part (部): the part of a university for one study, a faculty.
御 shows respect: put ご (or お) before a word to make it polite.
踏 has a foot (足): put your foot down, step on.
盗 has a dish (皿): someone takes from your dish, steals.
沸 has water (氵): the water bubbles up, it boils.
折 has a hand (扌) and axe (斤): snap a branch by hand or axe, break or fold.
柔 has a tree (木): young branches bend easily, soft.
過 has the road part (辶): go past on the road, to pass or exceed.
揺 has a hand (扌): a hand shakes it, it sways.
落 has grass (艹) and water (氵): leaves fall into the water, to fall.
致 means to bring about: the humble way to say する, いたします.
噛 has a mouth (口) and teeth (歯): bite and chew.
Say humbly (申し) + raise up (上げる): humbly offer your words up to someone.
寄 has a roof (宀): drop by under someone's roof.
包 is a baby wrapped up inside: to wrap.
無 means nothing: it becomes nothing, it disappears.
痩 has the sickness part (疒): sick people get thin, lose weight.
漬 has water (氵): put it in liquid to soak or pickle.
乾 has the sun (日) inside: the sun makes things dry.
連 has a vehicle (車) on the road (辶): carts in a line, take someone along.
楽 means fun: to have fun, to enjoy.
Hold out (差し) + raise up (上げる): humbly hold a gift up to someone.
凄 has ice (冫): so great it gives you chills.
写 means copy: copy a picture, take a photo.
釣 has metal (金): a metal hook to catch fish.
叱 has a mouth (口): use your mouth to scold.
沸 has water (氵): make the water boil.
折 has a hand (扌) and axe (斤): the branch gets snapped, it breaks or bends.
滑 has water (氵) and bone (骨): wet bones slip, to slide.
All mean hard: 堅 has earth (土), 硬 has stone (石), 固 is shut in a box (囗).
騒 has a horse (馬): excited horses make lots of noise.
High (高) + school (校): high school, short for 高等学校.
似 has a person (亻): one person looks like another.
褒 has clothes (衣): give someone fine robes to praise them.
見 means see: someone sees it, it is found.
太 is big (大) plus a dot: get bigger, gain weight.
直 means straight: it is made straight again, fixed.
焼 has fire (火): it burns or gets roasted.
点 has fire (灬) at the bottom: the light comes on.
落 has grass (艹) and water (氵): leaves drop into the water, to drop.
回 is a box turning inside a box: to go around, to turn.
濡 has water (氵) and rain (雨): you get wet.
倒 has a person (亻): a person falls down, collapses.
Take (取り) + change (替える): take one out, put another in, replace.
参 means to visit (a shrine): humbly go or come.
Ride (乗り) + change (換える): change trains or buses.
集 is a bird (隹) on a tree (木): birds gather.

One single line (一) means one.
何 was first drawn as a person (亻) carrying a load: "What is that?" (なに).
A tree (木) with a mark at its base: the root or origin, and also a book.

A line going through the middle of a box: 中 is the inside or middle.
手 looks like a hand with fingers spread; "te" like the start of "ten fingers".
Words (言) from the tongue (舌): talking, telling a story.
Time (時) + interval (間): a span of time.
Meet (会) + company (社): a place where people meet to work, a company.
A roof (宀) over a pig (豕): in old China the home kept pigs under the roof.
前 means front or before: "Ma, eh? Look in front!"
Born (生) before (先) you: the person who knows more, your teacher.
Serve (仕) + matter (事): the things you do to serve, your job.
今 means now: "I'm a" student now (いま).
私 means private, myself: I keep my own rice plant (禾) private.

Section (部) + roof or house (屋): a section of the house, a room.
Electric (電) + vehicle (車): an electric train.
年 means year; the years you have lived are your age (とし).
Now (今) + day (日): the day that is now, today (special reading きょう).
A building (广) where goods are shown: 店 is a shop; "me, see" the shop (みせ).
Stand (立) by a tree (木) and cut it with an axe (斤): fresh, new wood.
A woman (女) with her child (子): the love she feels, liking.
上 is a line pointing up from the ground: above, on top.
Bright (明) + day (日): the next bright day, tomorrow (special reading あした).

Electric (電) + talk (話): talking by electricity, the telephone.
Two lines (二) for two; you have two knees (に).
Self (自) + part (分): your own part, oneself.
後 means behind or after: what comes after, later.
Materials (料) + logic (理): putting ingredients together with skill, cooking.
先 means ahead: the place ahead of you, or the time before.
車 looks like a cart from above, a wheel on an axle: it comes (くる) rolling.
Copy (写) + truth (真): a true copy of what you see, a photo.
One (一) + person (人): one person, alone (special reading ひとり).
Every (毎) + day (日): every day.

父 shows hands holding a tool: the hard working father.
A person (亻) resting by a tree (木): rest, a day off.
Hand (手) + paper (紙): paper you write by hand, a letter.
The sun rising in the grass while the moon (月) is still out: morning.
Under a roof (亠), a person (亻) and the evening moon (夕): night.
Study (学) + life (生): a person whose life is study, a student.
Effort (勉) + strong (強): working hard and strong, studying.

One (一) + number or turn (番): number one, the best.
House (家) + tribe (族): the group in one house, your family.
女 looks like a woman kneeling with crossed arms: woman.
Three lines (三) for three; "sun" sounds like さん.
金 means gold or money; お makes it polite: money.
An ox (牛) on the left: an ox was a valuable thing, an object.
The horse (馬) on the left: stations were where travellers changed horses.
Study (学) + school (校): a place for study, a school.
One (一) thing: ひとつ, counting objects with つ.
Two (二) + person (人): two people (special reading ふたり).

近 has the road part (辶): only a short road to go, nearby.
Big (大) + cut (切): something that cuts deep into your heart is important.
Sun (日) + weekday (曜日): the sun's day, Sunday.
Previous (昨) + day (日): the day before, yesterday (special reading きのう).
Every (毎) + morning (朝): every morning.
Question (問) + topic (題): a question topic, a problem.
大 is a person with arms stretched wide to show something big.
Origin (本) + hit (当): it hits the true origin, real.
方 means direction or way: a polite way to point to a person, or a way of doing.
The thread (糸) part: paper was made from fibres.
One (一) + cord (緒): tied by one cord, together.
Blue (青) + fight (争): the fight turns calm and blue, quiet.
Whole (全) + part (部): all the parts, everything.
Rice field (田) + street (丁): fields with streets become a town.
Upper (上) + hand (手): having the upper hand, skillful.
目 is an eye turned on its side; "me" sees with my eyes.
Journey (旅) + go (行): going on a journey, a trip.
Clothing (衤) + knife (刀): cutting the cloth is the first step, the first time.
Refine (練) + learn (習): learning by doing it again and again, practice.
下 is a line pointing down from a bar: below, under.
来 means come: "Come!" sounds a bit like くる.
New (新) + hear (聞): new things you hear about, the newspaper.
Head (首) + road (辶): the road your head leads you along, the way.
Door (戸) + axe (斤): the place where you keep your tools, a place.

高 looks like a tall tower: tall, high, and a high price.
One (一) + day (日): one whole day, read いちにち.
One (一) + day (日), the first of the month: from つきたち, the moon (月) starts.
Origin (元) + spirit (気): your basic energy, healthy and lively.
言 is a mouth (口) with words coming out: to say.
Coming (来) + week (週): next week.
Field (田) + power (力): the one using power in the field, a man.
若 has grass (艹) on top: a fresh new sprout, young.
Head (頁) on the right: the front of your head, the face.

茶 has grass (艹) on top for tea leaves; "cha" like chai tea.
Self (自) + turn (転) + vehicle (車): a vehicle you turn yourself, a bicycle.
見 is an eye (目) on legs (儿): going to look, to see.

声 means voice: think of a choir voice singing "koe".
Tree (木) + measure (寸): a small place among the trees, a village.
小 shows a thing split into tiny bits: small.
Friend (友) + plural (達): your friends.

Time (時) + measure (計): a thing that measures time, a clock.

Sky (天) + air (気): what the air in the sky is like, the weather.
Idea (意) + taste (味): the taste of an idea, its meaning.
Sick (病) + institution (院): the place for sick people, a hospital.
Public (公) + garden (園): a public garden, a park.
Noon (午) + after (後): after noon, P.M.
Drawing (図) + writing (書) + building (館): a building for books, a library.

Electric (電) + energy (気): electricity, and the electric light.
